OLA ELECTRIC / SERVICE CRISIS ANALYTICS

Service deterioration preceded the late-2024 sales decline.

DASARI ABHAY | JAN 2023–DEC 2024

A study of service pressure, customer experience and competitive position. Synthetic project data modelled on public events; registration shares cover six manufacturers.

Ola share · Dec 2024

15.26%

Down 21.75 percentage points from December 2023.

Recorded sales

673,048

Cumulative recorded units, not an observed active fleet.

Known revenue

₹7,031.11 cr

Project-period revenue base; not crisis-related loss.

Vehicles per centre

1,086

December 2024; 620 active centres.

Complaints and sales two months later had r = −0.867 within 2024 (10 pairs), versus −0.181 across the full period (22 pairs). This is an association, not validated predictive accuracy.

Core question

Was the late-2024 sales collapse an unpredictable brand event — or a predictable, measurable consequence of a widening service-capacity gap that was visible in complaint data months in advance?

Predictable warning signs, rather than an entirely unexpected event. The project data shows mean repair time above 14 days by July, parts stockouts above 40% in July and CSAT below 3 by August—before the late-year deterioration in sales and market share. These signals made growing service pressure measurable and gave management an opportunity to intervene.

This supports an early-warning interpretation, not proof that the precise sales collapse was forecastable or caused by capacity alone. The 2024 two-month complaint–sales correlation was −0.867 across 10 pairs, but weakened to −0.181 across the full period. No independent predictive model was validated.

PHASE 1 · DATA ENGINEERING

Extraction, Mapping & Data Limitations

Data cleaning focused on consistent identifiers, dates, locations and types while preserving uncertainty. Source-to-model reconciliation matched the reported row counts for nine analytical datasets. Sales units and known revenue also reconciled exactly. Missing values, conflicting records and reconstructed social dates are explicitly disclosed rather than presented as verified observations.

This ledger records findings and validation results supplied during the project. It is not a fresh database scan or a complete audit of the final SQL script. Counts refer to the relevant validation snapshot and are not additive across issues.

How to read these numbers

  1. Present 1,84,399 as identifier associations, not unique customers or vehicles.
  2. Label revenue as known revenue; unknown values were not treated as zero.
  3. Label social timelines and sentiment-to-sales lag results as illustrative reconstructions.
  4. Label cumulative sales since January 2023 as a fleet-size proxy, not an observed on-road fleet.
  5. Stockout rate is based on centre-part-week records: 20,330 / 62,400 = 32.58%. Summed stockout days are not distinct calendar days.
  6. Current job-card status grouped by opening month is not historical month-end backlog.
  7. Classification agreement and forecast validation are separate concepts. Neither demonstrates overall dataset correctness.

Evidence boundary: this ledger records reported checks and retained limitations. It does not establish that the complete dataset is error-free.

The master ID map contains 1,84,399 identifier associations, including unmatched source records; this is not a count of unique vehicles.

All 50,000 social-media records contain undocumented seven-digit epoch values. Original values preserved. Verified historical timing remains unavailable. A separate illustrative reconstruction supports exploratory analysis only.

Six shared dimensions and nine facts connect sales, complaints, workshop activity and external signals.

-- Preview duplicate ticket groups before cleaning.
WITH tickets AS (
    SELECT '2023' AS source_year, ticket_id FROM public.raw_service_complaints_2023
    UNION ALL
    SELECT '2024', ticket_id FROM public.raw_service_complaints_2024
), groups AS (
    SELECT source_year, ticket_id, COUNT(*) AS rows_per_ticket
    FROM tickets
    WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(ticket_id), '') IS NOT NULL
        AND LOWER(BTRIM(ticket_id)) NOT IN ('null', '[null]')
    GROUP BY source_year, ticket_id
)
SELECT source_year,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rows_per_ticket > 1) AS duplicated_ticket_groups,
        SUM(rows_per_ticket - 1) AS proposed_duplicate_removals
FROM groups GROUP BY source_year ORDER BY source_year;

-- Run once on fresh replay imports; execute this transaction through COMMIT.
BEGIN;

SET LOCAL search_path TO public;

SET LOCAL TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata';

-- Restrict cleaning to untouched imports in new_ola_analytics_replay.
DO $fresh$
BEGIN
    IF current_database() <> 'new_ola_analytics_replay' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Fresh cleaning is restricted to new_ola_analytics_replay; do not run on your current database';
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.master_id_map) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Expected an empty master_id_map; do not append repeated associations';
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name
        = 'raw_service_complaints_2024' AND column_name = 'complaint_date_raw') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Already converted: use the cleaned-source load script instead';
    END IF;
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND
        table_name = 'raw_archived_sales_legacy' AND column_name = 'rev_inr_lakh') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Expected untouched legacy import columns';
    END IF;
END $fresh$;

CREATE SCHEMA raw_snapshot;

-- Preserve the original imported tables before cleaning.
DO $backup$
DECLARE
    r RECORD;
BEGIN
    FOR r IN SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename LIKE 'raw\_%'
        ESCAPE '\' LOOP
        EXECUTE format('CREATE TABLE raw_snapshot.%I AS TABLE public.%I', r.tablename, r.tablename);
    END LOOP;
END $backup$;

-- Convert blank and textual NULL markers to SQL NULL.
DO $clean$
DECLARE
    r RECORD;
BEGIN
    FOR r IN SELECT table_name, column_name FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name LIKE 'raw\_%' ESCAPE '\'
    AND data_type IN ('text', 'character varying', 'character') LOOP
        EXECUTE
            format('UPDATE public.%I SET %I=NULL WHERE LOWER(BTRIM(%I)) IN ('''',''[null]'',''null'')',
            r.table_name, r.column_name, r.column_name);
    END LOOP;
END $clean$;

-- TABLE: raw_service_complaints_2023
UPDATE raw_service_complaints_2023 SET
    vehicle_reg_no = NULLIF(TRIM(vehicle_reg_no), '[null]'),
    component_tag = NULLIF(TRIM(component_tag), '[null]'),
    severity = NULLIF(TRIM(severity), '[null]');

UPDATE raw_service_complaints_2023 SET tat_days = (resolution_date - complaint_date);

UPDATE raw_service_complaints_2023
SET component_extracted = CASE
    WHEN complaint_text ILIKE '%fork%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%brake%' OR complaint_text ILIKE
        '%suspension%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%handle vibrat%' THEN 'Brakes/Suspension'
    WHEN complaint_text ILIKE '%refund%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%invoice%' OR complaint_text ILIKE
        '%charged twice%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%booking amount%' THEN 'Refund/Billing'
    WHEN complaint_text ILIKE '%service center%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%service centre%' OR
        complaint_text ILIKE '%pickup%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%job card%' OR complaint_text ILIKE
        '%no response%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%spare part%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%slot%' THEN
        'Service Delay'
    WHEN complaint_text ILIKE '%charger%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%charging%' OR complaint_text
        ILIKE '%hypercharger%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%plug%' THEN 'Charger/Charging'
    WHEN complaint_text ILIKE '%range%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%battery%' OR complaint_text ILIKE
        '%bms%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%drain%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%charge shows%' THEN
        'Battery/Range'
    WHEN complaint_text ILIKE '%motor%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%grinding%' OR complaint_text ILIKE
        '%power cut%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%belt%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%jerk%' OR
        complaint_text ILIKE '%incline%' THEN 'Motor/Drivetrain'
    WHEN complaint_text ILIKE '%screen%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%display%' OR complaint_text ILIKE
        '%ota%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%moveos%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%speedometer%' OR
        complaint_text ILIKE '%cruise%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%reverse mode%' OR complaint_text
        ILIKE '%navigation%' THEN 'Software/Display'
    WHEN complaint_text ILIKE '%app%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%bluetooth%' OR complaint_text ILIKE
        '%sync%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%remote lock%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%key sharing%'
        THEN 'App/Connectivity'
    ELSE 'Unclassified' END;

-- TABLE: raw_social_media_posts
UPDATE raw_social_media_posts
SET post_timestamp_ist = CASE
    WHEN posted_epoch_raw::TEXT ~ '^[0-9]{10}$'
        THEN to_timestamp(posted_epoch_raw::DOUBLE PRECISION) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'
    WHEN posted_epoch_raw::TEXT ~ '^[0-9]{13}$'
        THEN to_timestamp(posted_epoch_raw::DOUBLE PRECISION / 1000) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'
    ELSE NULL END;

UPDATE raw_social_media_posts SET location_tag = NULLIF(TRIM(location_tag), '[null]');

-- TABLE: raw_archived_sales_legacy
UPDATE raw_archived_sales_legacy
SET model = CASE
    WHEN model = 'SP' THEN 'S1 Pro'
    WHEN model = 'SA' THEN 'S1 Air'
    WHEN model = 'SX' THEN 'S1 X'
    WHEN model = 'SXP' THEN 'S1 X+'
    WHEN model = 'SG' THEN 'S1 Gig'
    ELSE model
END;

-- TABLE: raw_warranty_claims
-- Convert USD claims at the project assumption of INR 84 per USD.
UPDATE raw_warranty_claims
SET claim_amount_inr = CASE UPPER(TRIM(currency))
        WHEN 'USD' THEN claim_amount * 84
        WHEN 'INR' THEN claim_amount
        ELSE NULL END,
    is_usd_converted = COALESCE(UPPER(TRIM(currency)) = 'USD', FALSE);

-- TABLE: raw_service_complaints_2024
UPDATE raw_service_complaints_2024 SET
    vehicle_reg_no = NULLIF(TRIM(vehicle_reg_no), '[null]'),
    component_tag = NULLIF(TRIM(component_tag), '[null]'),
    severity = NULLIF(TRIM(severity), '[null]');

UPDATE raw_service_complaints_2024
SET complaint_date = CASE
        WHEN TRIM(complaint_date_raw) IN ('', '[null]') THEN NULL
        WHEN TRIM(complaint_date_raw) ~ '^[0-9]{10}$'
            THEN (to_timestamp(TRIM(complaint_date_raw)::DOUBLE PRECISION)
                AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::DATE
        WHEN TRIM(complaint_date_raw) ~ '^[0-9]{13}$'
            THEN (to_timestamp(TRIM(complaint_date_raw)::DOUBLE PRECISION / 1000)
                AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::DATE
        WHEN TRIM(complaint_date_raw) ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN NULL
        WHEN TRIM(complaint_date_raw) ~ '(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})$'
            THEN (TRIM(complaint_date_raw)::TIMESTAMPTZ AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::DATE
        ELSE TRIM(complaint_date_raw)::TIMESTAMP::DATE END,
    resolution_date = CASE
        WHEN TRIM(resolution_date_raw) IN ('', '[null]') THEN NULL
        WHEN TRIM(resolution_date_raw) ~ '^[0-9]{10}$'
            THEN (to_timestamp(TRIM(resolution_date_raw)::DOUBLE PRECISION)
                AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::DATE
        WHEN TRIM(resolution_date_raw) ~ '^[0-9]{13}$'
            THEN (to_timestamp(TRIM(resolution_date_raw)::DOUBLE PRECISION / 1000)
                AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::DATE
        WHEN TRIM(resolution_date_raw) ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN NULL
        WHEN TRIM(resolution_date_raw) ~ '(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})$'
            THEN (TRIM(resolution_date_raw)::TIMESTAMPTZ AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::DATE
        ELSE TRIM(resolution_date_raw)::TIMESTAMP::DATE END;

UPDATE raw_service_complaints_2024 SET tat_days = (resolution_date - complaint_date);

UPDATE raw_service_complaints_2024
SET component_extracted = CASE
    WHEN complaint_text ILIKE '%fork%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%brake%' OR complaint_text ILIKE
        '%suspension%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%handle vibrat%' THEN 'Brakes/Suspension'
    WHEN complaint_text ILIKE '%refund%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%invoice%' OR complaint_text ILIKE
        '%charged twice%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%booking amount%' THEN 'Refund/Billing'
    WHEN complaint_text ILIKE '%service center%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%service centre%' OR
        complaint_text ILIKE '%pickup%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%job card%' OR complaint_text ILIKE
        '%no response%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%spare part%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%slot%' THEN
        'Service Delay'
    WHEN complaint_text ILIKE '%charger%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%charging%' OR complaint_text
        ILIKE '%hypercharger%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%plug%' THEN 'Charger/Charging'
    WHEN complaint_text ILIKE '%range%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%battery%' OR complaint_text ILIKE
        '%bms%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%drain%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%charge shows%' THEN
        'Battery/Range'
    WHEN complaint_text ILIKE '%motor%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%grinding%' OR complaint_text ILIKE
        '%power cut%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%belt%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%jerk%' OR
        complaint_text ILIKE '%incline%' THEN 'Motor/Drivetrain'
    WHEN complaint_text ILIKE '%screen%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%display%' OR complaint_text ILIKE
        '%ota%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%moveos%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%speedometer%' OR
        complaint_text ILIKE '%cruise%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%reverse mode%' OR complaint_text
        ILIKE '%navigation%' THEN 'Software/Display'
    WHEN complaint_text ILIKE '%app%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%bluetooth%' OR complaint_text ILIKE
        '%sync%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%remote lock%' OR complaint_text ILIKE '%key sharing%'
        THEN 'App/Connectivity'
    ELSE 'Unclassified' END;

-- TABLE: master_id_map
-- Retain unmatched associations when joining normalized identifiers.
WITH complaint_pairs AS (
    SELECT
        NULLIF(TRIM(customer_id), '') AS customer_id,
        NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(vehicle_reg_no)), '') AS vehicle_reg_no
    FROM raw_service_complaints_2023

    UNION

    SELECT
        NULLIF(TRIM(customer_id), ''),
        NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(vehicle_reg_no)), '')
    FROM raw_service_complaints_2024
),
warranty_pairs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(vehicle_reg_no)), '') AS vehicle_reg_no,
        NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(chassis_no)), '') AS chassis_no
    FROM raw_warranty_claims
),
job_pairs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(chassis_no)), '') AS chassis_no,
        NULLIF(TRIM(mobile_hash), '') AS mobile_hash
    FROM raw_job_cards_2024
),
multiple_customer_regs AS (
    SELECT vehicle_reg_no
    FROM complaint_pairs
    WHERE vehicle_reg_no IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY vehicle_reg_no
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) > 1
)

INSERT INTO master_id_map (
    customer_id,
    vehicle_reg_no,
    chassis_no,
    mobile_hash,
    multiple_customers_flag
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    c.customer_id,
    COALESCE(c.vehicle_reg_no, w.vehicle_reg_no),
    COALESCE(w.chassis_no, j.chassis_no),
    j.mobile_hash,
    m.vehicle_reg_no IS NOT NULL
FROM complaint_pairs c
FULL OUTER JOIN warranty_pairs w
    ON c.vehicle_reg_no = w.vehicle_reg_no
FULL OUTER JOIN job_pairs j
    ON w.chassis_no = j.chassis_no
LEFT JOIN multiple_customer_regs m
    ON m.vehicle_reg_no =
        COALESCE(c.vehicle_reg_no, w.vehicle_reg_no);

-- TABLE: raw_snapshot.deleted_complaints_2023
CREATE TABLE raw_snapshot.deleted_complaints_2023 AS
SELECT * FROM raw_service_complaints_2023 WITH NO DATA;

-- TABLE: raw_service_complaints_2023
-- Retain the highest-priority ticket row and audit removed duplicates.
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        ctid,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY ticket_id
            ORDER BY
                CASE UPPER(TRIM(status))
                    WHEN 'ESCALATED' THEN 1
                    WHEN 'OPEN' THEN 2
                    WHEN 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 2
                    WHEN 'IN PROGRESS' THEN 2
                    WHEN 'RESOLVED' THEN 3
                    WHEN 'CLOSED' THEN 3
                    ELSE 4
                END,
                resolution_date DESC NULLS LAST,
                complaint_date DESC NULLS LAST,
                TO_JSONB(c)::TEXT,
                ctid
        ) AS row_num
    FROM raw_service_complaints_2023 c
    WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(ticket_id), '') IS NOT NULL
)
, deleted AS (
    DELETE FROM raw_service_complaints_2023 c
    USING ranked r
    WHERE c.ctid = r.ctid AND r.row_num > 1
    RETURNING c.*
)
INSERT INTO raw_snapshot.deleted_complaints_2023
SELECT * FROM deleted;

-- TABLE: raw_snapshot.deleted_complaints_2024
CREATE TABLE raw_snapshot.deleted_complaints_2024 AS
SELECT * FROM raw_service_complaints_2024 WITH NO DATA;

-- TABLE: raw_service_complaints_2024
-- Retain the highest-priority ticket row and audit removed duplicates.
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        ctid,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY ticket_id
            ORDER BY
                CASE UPPER(TRIM(status))
                    WHEN 'ESCALATED' THEN 1
                    WHEN 'OPEN' THEN 2
                    WHEN 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 2
                    WHEN 'IN PROGRESS' THEN 2
                    WHEN 'RESOLVED' THEN 3
                    WHEN 'CLOSED' THEN 3
                    ELSE 4
                END,
                resolution_date DESC NULLS LAST,
                complaint_date DESC NULLS LAST,
                TO_JSONB(c)::TEXT,
                ctid
        ) AS row_num
    FROM raw_service_complaints_2024 c
    WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(ticket_id), '') IS NOT NULL
)
, deleted AS (
    DELETE FROM raw_service_complaints_2024 c
    USING ranked r
    WHERE c.ctid = r.ctid AND r.row_num > 1
    RETURNING c.*
)
INSERT INTO raw_snapshot.deleted_complaints_2024
SELECT * FROM deleted;

-- Reject ticket IDs shared by both years before committing.
DO $check$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
    SELECT ticket_id FROM raw_service_complaints_2023
    INTERSECT SELECT ticket_id FROM raw_service_complaints_2024
    ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Ticket ID occurs in both years; review source ownership before loading';
    END IF;
END $check$;

-- Count duplicate rows removed from each year.
SELECT '2023' AS source_year, COUNT(*) AS removed_duplicates
FROM raw_snapshot.deleted_complaints_2023
UNION ALL
SELECT '2024', COUNT(*) FROM raw_snapshot.deleted_complaints_2024;

COMMIT;

-- Restrict schema creation to the project database.
BEGIN;

DO $check$
BEGIN
    IF current_database() <> 'new_ola_analytics' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Connect to new_ola_analytics';
    END IF;
END $check$;
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS ola_star;
SET search_path TO ola_star, public;
SET TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata';

COMMIT;

-- TABLE: dim_city
BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dim_city (
    city_name VARCHAR(100) PRIMARY KEY,
    tier VARCHAR(20),
    service_region TEXT
);

COMMIT;

-- TABLE: dim_date
BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dim_date (
    date_key DATE PRIMARY KEY,
    year INT NOT NULL CHECK (year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_key)),
    month INT NOT NULL CHECK (month BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND month = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_key)),
    month_name VARCHAR(20),
    quarter INT CHECK (quarter BETWEEN 1 AND 4 AND quarter = EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM date_key)),
    day_of_week VARCHAR(20)
);

COMMIT;

-- TABLE: dim_oem
BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dim_oem (
    oem_name VARCHAR(100) PRIMARY KEY
);

COMMIT;

-- TABLE: dim_part
BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dim_part (
    part_key BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    member_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (member_type IN ('PART', 'COMPONENT')),
    member_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    part_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    category VARCHAR(100),
    UNIQUE (member_type, member_code)
);

COMMIT;

-- TABLE: dim_service_center
BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dim_service_center (
    center_id VARCHAR(50) PRIMARY KEY,
    city VARCHAR(100),
    opened_date DATE,
    type VARCHAR(50),
    center_name VARCHAR(100),
    capacity_jobs_per_day INT CHECK (capacity_jobs_per_day >= 0),
    technicians_count INT CHECK (technicians_count >= 0),
    source_record_missing BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_center_city ON dim_service_center (city);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_center_opened ON dim_service_center (opened_date);

COMMIT;

-- TABLE: dim_vehicle_customer
BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dim_vehicle_customer (
    vehicle_customer_key BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    identity_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (identity_type IN ('CHASSIS', 'REGISTRATION', 'CUSTOMER_ONLY',
        'MOBILE_ONLY')),
    identity_value TEXT NOT NULL,
    customer_id VARCHAR(100),
    vehicle_reg_no VARCHAR(100),
    chassis_no VARCHAR(100),
    mobile_hash VARCHAR(255),
    multiple_customers_flag BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    UNIQUE (identity_type, identity_value)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_dim_vc_cust ON dim_vehicle_customer (customer_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_dim_vc_reg ON dim_vehicle_customer (vehicle_reg_no);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_dim_vc_chas ON dim_vehicle_customer (chassis_no);

COMMIT;

-- TABLE: fact_sales
BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fact_sales (
    sale_id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    sale_date DATE NOT NULL REFERENCES dim_date(date_key),
    city VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL REFERENCES dim_city(city_name),
    model VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    units_sold INT NOT NULL CHECK (units_sold >= 0),
    revenue NUMERIC CHECK (revenue >= 0),
    source_system VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    oem VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL REFERENCES dim_oem(oem_name),
    state VARCHAR(50),
    dealer_type VARCHAR(50),
    booking_channel VARCHAR(50),
    avg_selling_price_inr NUMERIC CHECK (avg_selling_price_inr >= 0),
    UNIQUE (sale_date, city, model)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sales_date ON fact_sales (sale_date);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sales_city ON fact_sales (city);

COMMIT;

-- TABLE: fact_complaints
BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fact_complaints (
    ticket_id VARCHAR(50) PRIMARY KEY,
    complaint_date DATE REFERENCES dim_date(date_key),
    complaint_date_inferred DATE REFERENCES dim_date(date_key),
    resolution_date DATE REFERENCES dim_date(date_key),
    customer_id VARCHAR(100),
    vehicle_reg_no VARCHAR(100),
    vehicle_customer_key BIGINT REFERENCES dim_vehicle_customer(vehicle_customer_key),
    city VARCHAR(100) REFERENCES dim_city(city_name),
    part_key BIGINT REFERENCES dim_part(part_key),
    oem VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL REFERENCES dim_oem(oem_name),
    status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    severity VARCHAR(20),
    channel VARCHAR(20),
    complaint_text TEXT,
    component_tag VARCHAR(50),
    tat_days INT CHECK (tat_days >= 0),
    csat_score NUMERIC CHECK (csat_score BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
    assigned_center_id VARCHAR(50) REFERENCES dim_service_center(center_id),
    CHECK (resolution_date IS NULL OR complaint_date IS NULL OR resolution_date >= complaint_date),
    CHECK (tat_days IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (resolution_date - complaint_date))
);

ALTER TABLE fact_complaints ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS component_extracted VARCHAR(50);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_complaints_date ON fact_complaints (complaint_date);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_complaints_city ON fact_complaints (city);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_complaints_vehicle ON fact_complaints (vehicle_customer_key);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_complaints_reg ON fact_complaints (vehicle_reg_no);

COMMIT;

-- TABLE: fact_jobcards
BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fact_jobcards (
    jobcard_id VARCHAR(50) PRIMARY KEY,
    chassis_no VARCHAR(100),
    mobile_hash VARCHAR(255),

    vehicle_customer_key BIGINT
        REFERENCES dim_vehicle_customer(vehicle_customer_key),

    center_id VARCHAR(50)
        REFERENCES dim_service_center(center_id),

    city VARCHAR(100)
        REFERENCES dim_city(city_name),

    oem VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL
        REFERENCES dim_oem(oem_name),

    open_date DATE NOT NULL
        REFERENCES dim_date(date_key),

    close_date DATE
        REFERENCES dim_date(date_key),

    technician_id VARCHAR(50),
    issue_category VARCHAR(50),
    parts_replaced INT CHECK (parts_replaced >= 0),
    parts_cost_inr NUMERIC CHECK (parts_cost_inr >= 0),
    labour_cost_inr NUMERIC CHECK (labour_cost_inr >= 0),
    status VARCHAR(50),

    linked_ticket_id VARCHAR(50),
    linked_ticket_key VARCHAR(50),

    CHECK (
        close_date IS NULL
        OR close_date >= open_date
    ),

    CHECK (
        linked_ticket_key IS NULL
        OR linked_ticket_key = linked_ticket_id
    )
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_jobcards_date
    ON fact_jobcards (open_date);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_jobcards_city
    ON fact_jobcards (city);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_jobcards_chassis_date
    ON fact_jobcards (chassis_no, open_date);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_jobcards_ticket
    ON fact_jobcards (linked_ticket_key);

COMMIT;

-- TABLE: fact_warranty
BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fact_warranty (
    claim_id VARCHAR(50) PRIMARY KEY,
    claim_date DATE NOT NULL REFERENCES dim_date(date_key),
    chassis_no VARCHAR(100),
    vehicle_reg_no VARCHAR(100),
    vehicle_customer_key BIGINT REFERENCES dim_vehicle_customer(vehicle_customer_key),
    part_key BIGINT REFERENCES dim_part(part_key),
    part_name VARCHAR(100),
    dealer_center_id VARCHAR(50) REFERENCES dim_service_center(center_id),
    city VARCHAR(100) REFERENCES dim_city(city_name),
    oem VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL REFERENCES dim_oem(oem_name),
    claim_amount_inr NUMERIC NOT NULL CHECK (claim_amount_inr >= 0),
    is_usd_converted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    approved_flag VARCHAR(50) CHECK (approved_flag IN ('APPROVED', 'PENDING', 'REJECTED')),
    km_at_claim INT CHECK (km_at_claim >= 0)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_warranty_date ON fact_warranty (claim_date);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_warranty_city ON fact_warranty (city);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_warranty_vehicle ON fact_warranty (vehicle_customer_key);

COMMIT;

-- TABLE: fact_vahan_registrations
BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fact_vahan_registrations (
    reg_date DATE NOT NULL REFERENCES dim_date(date_key),
    rto_city VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL REFERENCES dim_city(city_name),
    oem VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL REFERENCES dim_oem(oem_name),
    vehicle_class VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    registrations INT NOT NULL CHECK (registrations >= 0),
    PRIMARY KEY (reg_date, rto_city, oem, vehicle_class)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_vahan_date ON fact_vahan_registrations (reg_date);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_vahan_city ON fact_vahan_registrations (rto_city);

COMMIT;

-- TABLE: fact_spare_parts
BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fact_spare_parts (
    week_start DATE NOT NULL REFERENCES dim_date(date_key),
    center_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL REFERENCES dim_service_center(center_id),
    city VARCHAR(100) REFERENCES dim_city(city_name),
    part_code VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    part_key BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES dim_part(part_key),
    part_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    consumption_qty INT CHECK (consumption_qty >= 0),
    stockout_days INT NOT NULL CHECK (stockout_days BETWEEN 0 AND 7),
    reorder_flag BOOLEAN,
    PRIMARY KEY (week_start, center_id, part_code)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_spares_date ON fact_spare_parts (week_start);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_spares_city ON fact_spare_parts (city);

COMMIT;

-- TABLE: fact_sentiment
BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fact_sentiment (
    feedback_id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    source VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('App Store', 'Social Media')),
    source_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    feedback_date DATE REFERENCES dim_date(date_key),
    rating INT CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
    sentiment_label VARCHAR(20) CHECK (sentiment_label IN ('Positive', 'Negative', 'Neutral')),
    classification_method TEXT NOT NULL,
    platform VARCHAR(30),
    feedback_text TEXT,
    posted_epoch_raw BIGINT,
    likes INT CHECK (likes >= 0),
    shares INT CHECK (shares >= 0),
    comments INT CHECK (comments >= 0),
    UNIQUE (source, source_id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sentiment_date ON fact_sentiment (feedback_date);

COMMIT;

-- TABLE: fact_nch_complaints
BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fact_nch_complaints (
    nch_ref_id VARCHAR(50) PRIMARY KEY,
    filed_date DATE REFERENCES dim_date(date_key),
    state VARCHAR(50),
    category VARCHAR(50),
    status VARCHAR(30),
    escalated_to_ccpa BOOLEAN,
    resolution_days INT CHECK (resolution_days >= 0),
    compensation_inr NUMERIC CHECK (compensation_inr >= 0)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_nch_date ON fact_nch_complaints (filed_date);

COMMIT;

-- TABLE: fact_competitor_incidents
BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fact_competitor_incidents (
    incident_id VARCHAR(50) PRIMARY KEY,
    oem VARCHAR(100) REFERENCES dim_oem(oem_name),
    incident_date DATE REFERENCES dim_date(date_key),
    incident_type VARCHAR(50),
    units_affected INT CHECK (units_affected >= 0),
    resolution_days INT CHECK (resolution_days >= 0),
    source VARCHAR(100)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_incidents_date ON fact_competitor_incidents (incident_date);

COMMIT;

-- VIEW: vw_vehicle_identifier_map
BEGIN;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_vehicle_identifier_map AS
WITH registration_bridge AS (
    SELECT vehicle_reg_no, MIN(chassis_no) AS chassis_no
    FROM public.master_id_map WHERE vehicle_reg_no IS NOT NULL GROUP BY vehicle_reg_no
), identified AS (
    SELECT m.customer_id, m.vehicle_reg_no, m.chassis_no, m.mobile_hash,
            CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.chassis_no, b.chassis_no) IS NOT NULL THEN 'CHASSIS'
                WHEN m.vehicle_reg_no IS NOT NULL THEN 'REGISTRATION'
                WHEN m.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'CUSTOMER_ONLY' ELSE 'MOBILE_ONLY' END AS
                    identity_type,
            COALESCE(m.chassis_no, b.chassis_no, m.vehicle_reg_no, m.customer_id, m.mobile_hash) AS
                identity_value
    FROM public.master_id_map m LEFT JOIN registration_bridge b USING (vehicle_reg_no)
)
SELECT m.customer_id, m.vehicle_reg_no, m.chassis_no, m.mobile_hash, v.vehicle_customer_key
FROM identified m LEFT JOIN dim_vehicle_customer v USING (identity_type, identity_value);

COMMIT;

-- VIEW: vw_city_service_gap
BEGIN;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_city_service_gap AS
WITH months AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT make_date(year, month, 1) AS month_start FROM dim_date WHERE year IN (2023,
        2024)
), sales AS (
    SELECT date_trunc('month', sale_date)::date AS month_start, city, SUM(units_sold) AS units
    FROM fact_sales GROUP BY 1, 2
), complaints AS (
    SELECT date_trunc('month', complaint_date)::date AS month_start, city, COUNT(*) AS tickets
    FROM fact_complaints WHERE complaint_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2
), grid AS (
    SELECT m.month_start, c.city_name AS city, COALESCE(s.units, 0) AS monthly_sales,
            COALESCE(t.tickets, 0) AS monthly_complaints
    FROM months m CROSS JOIN dim_city c
    LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.month_start = m.month_start AND s.city = c.city_name
    LEFT JOIN complaints t ON t.month_start = m.month_start AND t.city = c.city_name
), fleet AS (
    SELECT *, SUM(monthly_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY month_start ROWS UNBOUNDED
        PRECEDING) AS cumulative_vehicles
    FROM grid
), capacity AS (
    SELECT m.month_start, c.city, COUNT(*) AS active_centers,
            SUM(c.capacity_jobs_per_day) AS capacity_jobs_per_day
    FROM months m JOIN dim_service_center c
        ON c.opened_date < m.month_start + INTERVAL '1 month' AND NOT c.source_record_missing
    GROUP BY m.month_start, c.city
)
SELECT f.*, COALESCE(c.active_centers, 0) AS active_centers, c.capacity_jobs_per_day,
        ROUND(f.cumulative_vehicles / NULLIF(c.active_centers, 0), 2) AS vehicles_per_center,
        ROUND(f.monthly_complaints * 1000.0 / NULLIF(f.cumulative_vehicles, 0), 2) AS
            complaints_per_1000_vehicles
FROM fleet f LEFT JOIN capacity c USING (month_start, city);

COMMIT;

-- VIEW: vw_monthly_kpis
BEGIN;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_monthly_kpis AS
WITH fleet AS (
    SELECT month_start, SUM(monthly_sales) AS monthly_sales, SUM(cumulative_vehicles) AS
        cumulative_vehicles,
            SUM(active_centers) AS active_centers FROM vw_city_service_gap GROUP BY month_start
), complaints AS (
    SELECT date_trunc('month', complaint_date)::date AS month_start, COUNT(*) AS total_complaints,
            AVG(tat_days) AS avg_tat_days, COUNT(tat_days) AS known_tat_tickets,
            AVG(csat_score) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(TRIM(status)) IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED')) AS
                avg_csat_score,
            COUNT(csat_score) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(TRIM(status)) IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED')) AS
                csat_rated_resolved_tickets,
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(TRIM(status)) = 'ESCALATED') AS escalated_tickets
    FROM fact_complaints WHERE complaint_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1
), registrations AS (
    SELECT date_trunc('month', reg_date)::date AS month_start, SUM(registrations) AS
        total_registrations,
            SUM(registrations) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(TRIM(oem)) = 'ola electric') AS ola_registrations
    FROM fact_vahan_registrations GROUP BY 1
), spares AS (
    SELECT date_trunc('month', week_start)::date AS month_start,
            CASE WHEN COUNT(stockout_days) = COUNT(*) THEN
                COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE stockout_days > 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) END AS
                    stockout_rate_pct
    FROM fact_spare_parts GROUP BY 1
), social AS (
    SELECT date_trunc('month', feedback_date)::date AS month_start, COUNT(*) AS dated_social_posts,
            CASE WHEN COUNT(sentiment_label) = COUNT(*) THEN
                (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sentiment_label = 'Positive') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE
                    sentiment_label = 'Negative'))::numeric
                / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) END AS sentiment_index
    FROM fact_sentiment WHERE source = 'Social Media' AND feedback_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1
), jobs AS (
    SELECT date_trunc('month', open_date)::date AS month_start,
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(TRIM(status)) = 'AWAITING_PARTS') * 100.0 /
                NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS awaiting_parts_pct
    FROM fact_jobcards GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.month_start)::int AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.month_start)::int AS
    month,
        f.month_start, f.monthly_sales, f.cumulative_vehicles, f.active_centers,
        COALESCE(c.total_complaints, 0) AS total_complaints,
        ROUND(c.avg_tat_days, 2) AS avg_tat_days, c.known_tat_tickets,
        ROUND(c.avg_csat_score, 2) AS avg_csat_score, c.csat_rated_resolved_tickets,
        ROUND(COALESCE(c.total_complaints, 0)*1000.0 / NULLIF(f.cumulative_vehicles, 0), 2) AS
            complaints_per_1000_vehicles,
        ROUND(f.cumulative_vehicles / NULLIF(f.active_centers, 0), 2) AS vehicles_per_center,
        ROUND(c.escalated_tickets*100.0 / NULLIF(c.total_complaints, 0), 2) AS escalation_rate_pct,
        ROUND(r.ola_registrations*100.0 / NULLIF(r.total_registrations, 0), 2) AS
            ola_market_share_pct,
        ROUND(s.stockout_rate_pct, 2) AS stockout_rate_pct,
        so.dated_social_posts, ROUND(so.sentiment_index, 4) AS sentiment_index,
        ROUND(j.awaiting_parts_pct, 2) AS awaiting_parts_pct
FROM fleet f LEFT JOIN complaints c USING(month_start) LEFT JOIN registrations r USING(month_start)
LEFT JOIN spares s USING(month_start) LEFT JOIN social so USING(month_start) LEFT JOIN jobs j
    USING(month_start);

COMMIT;

-- VIEW: vw_cross_validation_discrepancies
BEGIN;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_cross_validation_discrepancies AS
SELECT c.ticket_id, c.status AS complaint_status, j.jobcard_id, j.status AS jobcard_status
FROM fact_complaints c JOIN fact_jobcards j ON j.linked_ticket_key = c.ticket_id
WHERE UPPER(TRIM(c.status)) IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED')
    AND UPPER(TRIM(j.status)) IN ('OPEN', 'AWAITING_PARTS');

COMMIT;

-- VIEW: public.vw_legacy_sales_conflicts
BEGIN;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.vw_legacy_sales_conflicts AS
SELECT
    l.sale_date,
    l.city,
    l.model,
    l.units_sold AS legacy_units_sold,
    n.units_sold AS new_units_sold,
    n.units_sold - l.units_sold AS units_difference,
    'New system wins'::TEXT AS resolution_rule
FROM public.raw_archived_sales_legacy l
JOIN public.raw_ola_sales_daily_2023 n
    ON l.sale_date = n.sale_date
    AND l.city = n.city
    AND l.model = n.model
WHERE l.units_sold IS DISTINCT FROM n.units_sold;

COMMIT;

-- Requires cleaned sources and the star schema; run in one connection.
BEGIN;
DO $check$
BEGIN
    IF current_database() <> 'new_ola_analytics' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Connect to new_ola_analytics';
    END IF;
END $check$;
SET search_path TO ola_star, public;
SET TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata';
COMMIT;

-- TABLE: public.dict_city_lookup
BEGIN;

INSERT INTO public.dict_city_lookup (raw_name, clean_name) VALUES
    ('bangalore', 'Bengaluru'), ('bombay', 'Mumbai'), ('calcutta', 'Kolkata'),
    ('madras', 'Chennai'), ('gurgaon', 'Gurugram'), ('poona', 'Pune'),
    ('trivandrum', 'Thiruvananthapuram'), ('pondicherry', 'Puducherry'),
    ('benares', 'Varanasi'), ('cochin', 'Kochi'), ('kovai', 'Coimbatore'),
    ('vizag', 'Visakhapatnam'), ('trichy', 'Tiruchirappalli'),
    ('hubli', 'Hubballi'), ('mysore', 'Mysuru')
ON CONFLICT (raw_name) DO UPDATE SET clean_name = EXCLUDED.clean_name;
INSERT INTO public.dict_city_lookup (raw_name, clean_name)
VALUES
    ('bhubaneswa', 'Bhubaneswar'),
    ('tiruchirap', 'Tiruchirappalli'),
    ('visakhapat', 'Visakhapatnam')
ON CONFLICT (raw_name)
DO UPDATE SET clean_name = EXCLUDED.clean_name;

DO $keys$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM ola_star.fact_sales f
        WHERE f.city IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(
            (SELECT d.clean_name FROM public.dict_city_lookup d
                WHERE d.raw_name = LOWER(BTRIM(f.city))), INITCAP(NULLIF(BTRIM(f.city), '')))
    ) OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM ola_star.fact_vahan_registrations f
        WHERE f.rto_city IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(
            (SELECT d.clean_name FROM public.dict_city_lookup d
                WHERE d.raw_name = LOWER(BTRIM(f.rto_city))), INITCAP(NULLIF(BTRIM(f.rto_city),
                    '')))
            OR f.oem IS DISTINCT FROM UPPER(BTRIM(f.oem))
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Existing sales/VAHAN keys need migration; stop before normalizing source cities or reloading';
    END IF;
END $keys$;

    d.raw_name = LOWER(BTRIM(s.city))), INITCAP(NULLIF(BTRIM(s.city), '')));

WHERE s.city IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE((SELECT clean_name FROM public.dict_city_lookup d WHERE
