-- TABLE: _src_complaints
BEGIN;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS pg_temp._src_complaints;

CREATE TEMP TABLE _src_complaints ON COMMIT PRESERVE ROWS AS
SELECT ticket_id, customer_id, vehicle_reg_no, city, complaint_date, resolution_date,
        channel, complaint_text, component_tag, component_extracted, severity, status,
        csat_score, assigned_center_id, NULL::DATE AS complaint_date_inferred
FROM public.raw_service_complaints_2023
UNION ALL
SELECT ticket_id, customer_id, vehicle_reg_no, city, complaint_date, resolution_date,
        channel, complaint_text, component_tag, component_extracted, severity, status,
        csat_score, assigned_center_id, complaint_date_inferred
FROM public.raw_service_complaints_2024;

COMMIT;

-- TABLE: _src_sales
BEGIN;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS pg_temp._src_sales;

-- New-system sales take precedence over overlapping legacy rows.
CREATE TEMP TABLE _src_sales ON COMMIT PRESERVE ROWS AS
SELECT sale_date, city, model, units_sold,
        units_sold * avg_selling_price_inr AS revenue, 'New_2024'::TEXT AS source_system,
        state, dealer_type, booking_channel, avg_selling_price_inr
FROM public.raw_ola_sales_daily_2024
UNION ALL
SELECT sale_date, city, model, units_sold, units_sold * avg_selling_price_inr,
        'New_2023', state, dealer_type, booking_channel, avg_selling_price_inr
FROM public.raw_ola_sales_daily_2023
UNION ALL
SELECT l.sale_date, l.city, l.model, l.units_sold, l.revenue, 'Legacy_2023',
        NULL::VARCHAR, NULL::VARCHAR, NULL::VARCHAR, NULL::NUMERIC
FROM public.raw_archived_sales_legacy l
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.raw_ola_sales_daily_2023 n
    WHERE n.sale_date = l.sale_date AND n.city = l.city AND n.model = l.model
);

COMMIT;

-- Reject duplicate source keys and ambiguous vehicle identifiers.
BEGIN;

DO $guard$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_vahan_registrations WHERE oem <> UPPER(BTRIM(oem))) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Existing VAHAN OEM keys are noncanonical: migrate these keys in a separate transaction before running this script';
    END IF;
END $guard$;
DO $check$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM _src_sales GROUP BY sale_date, city, model HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Sales grain is not unique: sale_date, city, model; investigate before loading';
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM _src_complaints GROUP BY ticket_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Duplicate cleaned ticket IDs; stop and review cleanup before loading';
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.master_id_map WHERE vehicle_reg_no IS NOT NULL
                GROUP BY vehicle_reg_no HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT chassis_no) > 1) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'A registration maps to several chassis; resolve identity before loading';
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.master_id_map
                WHERE COALESCE(customer_id, vehicle_reg_no, chassis_no, mobile_hash) IS NULL) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Identifier map contains an entirely unidentified row';
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.raw_spare_parts_consumption GROUP BY part_code
                HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT part_name) > 1 OR COUNT(part_name) < COUNT(*)) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Part codes have missing or conflicting names';
    END IF;
END $check$;

DO $map$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.master_id_map) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'master_id_map is empty; do not load vehicle-dependent facts';
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.master_id_map
        GROUP BY customer_id, vehicle_reg_no, chassis_no, mobile_hash
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Duplicate map associations; review repeated map INSERTs before loading';
    END IF;
END $map$;

COMMIT;

-- TABLE: _identity_map
BEGIN;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS pg_temp._identity_map;

-- Reuse map associations; choose chassis before other identifiers.
CREATE TEMP TABLE _identity_map ON COMMIT PRESERVE ROWS AS
WITH registration_bridge AS (
    SELECT vehicle_reg_no, MIN(chassis_no) AS chassis_no
    FROM public.master_id_map WHERE vehicle_reg_no IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY vehicle_reg_no
), enriched AS (
    SELECT m.*, COALESCE(m.chassis_no, b.chassis_no) AS canonical_chassis
    FROM public.master_id_map m
    LEFT JOIN registration_bridge b ON b.vehicle_reg_no = m.vehicle_reg_no
)
SELECT *, CASE WHEN canonical_chassis IS NOT NULL THEN 'CHASSIS'
                WHEN vehicle_reg_no IS NOT NULL THEN 'REGISTRATION'
                WHEN customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'CUSTOMER_ONLY'
                ELSE 'MOBILE_ONLY' END AS identity_type,
            COALESCE(canonical_chassis, vehicle_reg_no, customer_id, mobile_hash) AS identity_value
FROM enriched;

COMMIT;

-- TABLE: dim_city
BEGIN;

INSERT INTO dim_city (city_name)
SELECT city FROM (
    SELECT city FROM public.raw_ola_sales_daily_2023
    UNION SELECT city FROM public.raw_ola_sales_daily_2024
    UNION SELECT city FROM public.raw_archived_sales_legacy
    UNION SELECT city FROM public.raw_service_complaints_2023
    UNION SELECT city FROM public.raw_service_complaints_2024
    UNION SELECT city FROM public.raw_service_centers_master
    UNION SELECT rto_city FROM public.raw_vahan_competitor_registrations
) all_cities WHERE city IS NOT NULL
ON CONFLICT (city_name) DO NOTHING;

COMMIT;

-- TABLE: dim_date
BEGIN;

INSERT INTO dim_date (date_key, year, month, month_name, quarter, day_of_week)
WITH source_dates AS (
    SELECT DATE '2023-01-01' AS d UNION ALL SELECT DATE '2024-12-31'
    UNION ALL SELECT sale_date FROM _src_sales
    UNION ALL SELECT complaint_date FROM _src_complaints
    UNION ALL SELECT resolution_date FROM _src_complaints
    UNION ALL SELECT complaint_date_inferred FROM _src_complaints
    UNION ALL SELECT opened_date FROM public.raw_service_centers_master
    UNION ALL SELECT open_date FROM public.raw_job_cards_2024
    UNION ALL SELECT close_date FROM public.raw_job_cards_2024
    UNION ALL SELECT claim_date FROM public.raw_warranty_claims
    UNION ALL SELECT week_start FROM public.raw_spare_parts_consumption
    UNION ALL SELECT reg_date FROM public.raw_vahan_competitor_registrations
    UNION ALL SELECT review_date FROM public.raw_app_store_reviews
    UNION ALL SELECT post_timestamp_ist::DATE FROM public.raw_social_media_posts
    UNION ALL SELECT filed_date FROM public.raw_nch_ccpa_complaints
    UNION ALL SELECT incident_date FROM public.raw_competitor_incidents
), bounds AS (SELECT MIN(d) AS first_date, MAX(d) AS last_date FROM source_dates),
calendar AS (SELECT first_date + n AS datum FROM bounds,
                LATERAL generate_series(0, last_date - first_date) AS g(n))
SELECT datum, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM datum)::INT, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM datum)::INT,
        TRIM(TO_CHAR(datum, 'Month')), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM datum)::INT,
        TRIM(TO_CHAR(datum, 'Day')) FROM calendar
ON CONFLICT (date_key) DO UPDATE SET
    year = EXCLUDED.year, month = EXCLUDED.month, month_name = EXCLUDED.month_name,
    quarter = EXCLUDED.quarter, day_of_week = EXCLUDED.day_of_week;

COMMIT;

-- TABLE: dim_oem
BEGIN;

INSERT INTO dim_oem (oem_name)
SELECT UPPER(BTRIM(oem)) AS oem FROM public.raw_vahan_competitor_registrations WHERE oem IS NOT NULL
UNION SELECT UPPER(BTRIM(oem)) AS oem FROM public.raw_competitor_incidents WHERE oem IS NOT NULL
UNION SELECT 'OLA ELECTRIC'
ON CONFLICT (oem_name) DO NOTHING;

COMMIT;

-- TABLE: dim_part
BEGIN;

INSERT INTO dim_part (member_type, member_code, part_name, category)
SELECT 'PART', part_code, MIN(part_name), NULL::VARCHAR
FROM public.raw_spare_parts_consumption GROUP BY part_code
UNION ALL
SELECT 'COMPONENT', component, component, component FROM (
    SELECT component FROM public.raw_warranty_claims WHERE component IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT component_extracted FROM _src_complaints WHERE component_extracted IS NOT NULL
) components
ON CONFLICT (member_type, member_code) DO UPDATE SET
    part_name = EXCLUDED.part_name, category = EXCLUDED.category;

COMMIT;

-- TABLE: dim_service_center
BEGIN;

INSERT INTO dim_service_center (
    center_id, city, opened_date, type, center_name, capacity_jobs_per_day, technicians_count,
    source_record_missing
)
SELECT center_id, city, opened_date, center_type, center_name,
        capacity_jobs_per_day, technicians_count, FALSE
FROM public.raw_service_centers_master
ON CONFLICT (center_id) DO UPDATE SET
    city = EXCLUDED.city, opened_date = EXCLUDED.opened_date, type = EXCLUDED.type,
    center_name = EXCLUDED.center_name, capacity_jobs_per_day = EXCLUDED.capacity_jobs_per_day,
    technicians_count = EXCLUDED.technicians_count,
    source_record_missing = EXCLUDED.source_record_missing;

INSERT INTO dim_service_center (center_id, source_record_missing)
SELECT center_id, TRUE FROM (
    SELECT assigned_center_id AS center_id FROM _src_complaints
    UNION SELECT center_id FROM public.raw_job_cards_2024
    UNION SELECT dealer_center_id FROM public.raw_warranty_claims
    UNION SELECT center_id FROM public.raw_spare_parts_consumption
) referenced_centers WHERE center_id IS NOT NULL
ON CONFLICT (center_id) DO NOTHING;

COMMIT;

-- TABLE: dim_vehicle_customer
BEGIN;

INSERT INTO dim_vehicle_customer (
    identity_type, identity_value, customer_id, vehicle_reg_no, chassis_no, mobile_hash,
    multiple_customers_flag
)
SELECT identity_type, identity_value,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) = 1 THEN MIN(customer_id) END,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT vehicle_reg_no) = 1 THEN MIN(vehicle_reg_no) END,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT canonical_chassis) = 1 THEN MIN(canonical_chassis) END,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT mobile_hash) = 1 THEN MIN(mobile_hash) END,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) > 1
FROM _identity_map GROUP BY identity_type, identity_value
ON CONFLICT (identity_type, identity_value) DO UPDATE SET
    customer_id = EXCLUDED.customer_id, vehicle_reg_no = EXCLUDED.vehicle_reg_no,
    chassis_no = EXCLUDED.chassis_no, mobile_hash = EXCLUDED.mobile_hash,
    multiple_customers_flag = EXCLUDED.multiple_customers_flag;

COMMIT;

-- TABLE: _map_keys
BEGIN;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS pg_temp._map_keys;

CREATE TEMP TABLE _map_keys ON COMMIT PRESERVE ROWS AS
SELECT m.*, v.vehicle_customer_key FROM _identity_map m
JOIN dim_vehicle_customer v USING (identity_type, identity_value);

-- TABLE: _reg_keys
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS pg_temp._reg_keys;

CREATE TEMP TABLE _reg_keys ON COMMIT PRESERVE ROWS AS
SELECT vehicle_reg_no, MIN(vehicle_customer_key) AS vehicle_customer_key
FROM _map_keys WHERE vehicle_reg_no IS NOT NULL GROUP BY vehicle_reg_no
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT vehicle_customer_key) = 1;

-- TABLE: _chassis_keys
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS pg_temp._chassis_keys;

CREATE TEMP TABLE _chassis_keys ON COMMIT PRESERVE ROWS AS
SELECT canonical_chassis AS chassis_no, MIN(vehicle_customer_key) AS vehicle_customer_key
FROM _map_keys WHERE canonical_chassis IS NOT NULL GROUP BY canonical_chassis
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT vehicle_customer_key) = 1;

-- TABLE: _mobile_keys
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS pg_temp._mobile_keys;

CREATE TEMP TABLE _mobile_keys ON COMMIT PRESERVE ROWS AS
SELECT mobile_hash, MIN(vehicle_customer_key) AS vehicle_customer_key
FROM _map_keys WHERE mobile_hash IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mobile_hash
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT vehicle_customer_key) = 1;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ON _reg_keys (vehicle_reg_no);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ON _chassis_keys (chassis_no);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ON _mobile_keys (mobile_hash);

COMMIT;

-- TABLE: fact_sales
BEGIN;

INSERT INTO fact_sales (
    sale_date, city, model, units_sold, revenue, source_system, oem, state, dealer_type,
    booking_channel, avg_selling_price_inr
)
SELECT sale_date, city, model, units_sold, revenue, source_system, 'OLA ELECTRIC',
        state, dealer_type, booking_channel, avg_selling_price_inr FROM _src_sales
ON CONFLICT (sale_date, city, model) DO UPDATE SET
    units_sold = EXCLUDED.units_sold, revenue = EXCLUDED.revenue,
    source_system = EXCLUDED.source_system, oem = EXCLUDED.oem, state = EXCLUDED.state,
    dealer_type = EXCLUDED.dealer_type, booking_channel = EXCLUDED.booking_channel,
    avg_selling_price_inr = EXCLUDED.avg_selling_price_inr;

COMMIT;

-- TABLE: fact_complaints
BEGIN;

INSERT INTO fact_complaints (
    ticket_id, complaint_date, complaint_date_inferred, resolution_date, customer_id,
        vehicle_reg_no,
    vehicle_customer_key, city, part_key, oem, status, severity, channel, complaint_text,
        component_tag,
    tat_days, csat_score, assigned_center_id, component_extracted
)
SELECT c.ticket_id, c.complaint_date, c.complaint_date_inferred, c.resolution_date,
        c.customer_id, c.vehicle_reg_no, COALESCE(r.vehicle_customer_key, u.vehicle_customer_key),
        c.city, p.part_key, 'OLA ELECTRIC', c.status, c.severity, c.channel,
        c.complaint_text, c.component_tag, c.resolution_date - c.complaint_date,
        c.csat_score, c.assigned_center_id, c.component_extracted
FROM _src_complaints c
LEFT JOIN _reg_keys r ON r.vehicle_reg_no = c.vehicle_reg_no
LEFT JOIN dim_vehicle_customer u ON c.vehicle_reg_no IS NULL
        AND u.identity_type = 'CUSTOMER_ONLY' AND u.identity_value = c.customer_id
LEFT JOIN dim_part p ON p.member_type = 'COMPONENT' AND p.member_code = c.component_extracted
ON CONFLICT (ticket_id) DO UPDATE SET
    complaint_date = EXCLUDED.complaint_date,
    complaint_date_inferred = EXCLUDED.complaint_date_inferred,
    resolution_date = EXCLUDED.resolution_date, customer_id = EXCLUDED.customer_id,
    vehicle_reg_no = EXCLUDED.vehicle_reg_no, vehicle_customer_key = EXCLUDED.vehicle_customer_key,
    city = EXCLUDED.city, part_key = EXCLUDED.part_key, oem = EXCLUDED.oem, status =
        EXCLUDED.status,
    severity = EXCLUDED.severity, channel = EXCLUDED.channel, complaint_text =
        EXCLUDED.complaint_text,
    component_tag = EXCLUDED.component_tag, tat_days = EXCLUDED.tat_days,
    csat_score = EXCLUDED.csat_score, assigned_center_id = EXCLUDED.assigned_center_id,
    component_extracted = EXCLUDED.component_extracted;

COMMIT;

-- TABLE: fact_jobcards
BEGIN;

INSERT INTO fact_jobcards (
    jobcard_id, chassis_no, mobile_hash, vehicle_customer_key, center_id, city, oem, open_date,
    close_date, technician_id, issue_category, parts_replaced, parts_cost_inr, labour_cost_inr,
        status,
    linked_ticket_id, linked_ticket_key
)
SELECT j.jobcard_id, j.chassis_no, j.mobile_hash,
        COALESCE(k.vehicle_customer_key, m.vehicle_customer_key), j.center_id, sc.city,
            'OLA ELECTRIC',
        j.open_date, j.close_date, j.technician_id, j.issue_category, j.parts_replaced,
        j.parts_cost_inr, j.labour_cost_inr, j.status, j.linked_ticket_id, c.ticket_id
FROM public.raw_job_cards_2024 j
LEFT JOIN _chassis_keys k ON k.chassis_no = j.chassis_no
LEFT JOIN _mobile_keys m ON j.chassis_no IS NULL AND m.mobile_hash = j.mobile_hash
LEFT JOIN dim_service_center sc ON sc.center_id = j.center_id
LEFT JOIN fact_complaints c ON c.ticket_id = j.linked_ticket_id
ON CONFLICT (jobcard_id) DO UPDATE SET
    chassis_no = EXCLUDED.chassis_no, mobile_hash = EXCLUDED.mobile_hash,
    vehicle_customer_key = EXCLUDED.vehicle_customer_key, center_id = EXCLUDED.center_id,
    city = EXCLUDED.city, oem = EXCLUDED.oem, open_date = EXCLUDED.open_date,
    close_date = EXCLUDED.close_date, technician_id = EXCLUDED.technician_id,
    issue_category = EXCLUDED.issue_category, parts_replaced = EXCLUDED.parts_replaced,
    parts_cost_inr = EXCLUDED.parts_cost_inr, labour_cost_inr = EXCLUDED.labour_cost_inr,
    status = EXCLUDED.status, linked_ticket_id = EXCLUDED.linked_ticket_id,
    linked_ticket_key = EXCLUDED.linked_ticket_key;

COMMIT;

-- TABLE: fact_warranty
BEGIN;

INSERT INTO fact_warranty (
    claim_id, claim_date, chassis_no, vehicle_reg_no, vehicle_customer_key, part_key, part_name,
    dealer_center_id, city, oem, claim_amount_inr, is_usd_converted, approved_flag, km_at_claim
)
SELECT w.claim_id, w.claim_date::DATE, w.chassis_no, w.vehicle_reg_no,
        COALESCE(k.vehicle_customer_key, r.vehicle_customer_key), p.part_key, w.component,
        w.dealer_center_id, sc.city, 'OLA ELECTRIC', w.claim_amount_inr::NUMERIC,
        w.is_usd_converted, w.approved_flag, w.km_at_claim
FROM public.raw_warranty_claims w
LEFT JOIN _chassis_keys k ON k.chassis_no = w.chassis_no
LEFT JOIN _reg_keys r ON w.chassis_no IS NULL AND r.vehicle_reg_no = w.vehicle_reg_no
LEFT JOIN dim_part p ON p.member_type = 'COMPONENT' AND p.member_code = w.component
LEFT JOIN dim_service_center sc ON sc.center_id = w.dealer_center_id
ON CONFLICT (claim_id) DO UPDATE SET
    claim_date = EXCLUDED.claim_date, chassis_no = EXCLUDED.chassis_no,
    vehicle_reg_no = EXCLUDED.vehicle_reg_no, vehicle_customer_key = EXCLUDED.vehicle_customer_key,
    part_key = EXCLUDED.part_key, part_name = EXCLUDED.part_name,
    dealer_center_id = EXCLUDED.dealer_center_id, city = EXCLUDED.city, oem = EXCLUDED.oem,
    claim_amount_inr = EXCLUDED.claim_amount_inr, is_usd_converted = EXCLUDED.is_usd_converted,
    approved_flag = EXCLUDED.approved_flag, km_at_claim = EXCLUDED.km_at_claim;

COMMIT;

-- TABLE: fact_vahan_registrations
BEGIN;

INSERT INTO fact_vahan_registrations (reg_date, rto_city, oem, vehicle_class, registrations)
SELECT reg_date, rto_city, UPPER(BTRIM(oem)), vehicle_class, registrations FROM
    public.raw_vahan_competitor_registrations
ON CONFLICT (reg_date, rto_city, oem, vehicle_class) DO UPDATE SET
    registrations = EXCLUDED.registrations;

COMMIT;

-- TABLE: fact_spare_parts
BEGIN;

INSERT INTO fact_spare_parts (
    week_start, center_id, city, part_code, part_key, part_name, consumption_qty, stockout_days,
    reorder_flag
)
SELECT s.week_start, s.center_id, c.city, s.part_code, p.part_key, s.part_name,
        s.qty_consumed, s.stockout_days, s.reorder_flag
FROM public.raw_spare_parts_consumption s
LEFT JOIN dim_service_center c ON c.center_id = s.center_id
LEFT JOIN dim_part p ON p.member_type = 'PART' AND p.member_code = s.part_code
ON CONFLICT (week_start, center_id, part_code) DO UPDATE SET
    city = EXCLUDED.city, part_key = EXCLUDED.part_key, part_name = EXCLUDED.part_name,
    consumption_qty = EXCLUDED.consumption_qty, stockout_days = EXCLUDED.stockout_days,
    reorder_flag = EXCLUDED.reorder_flag;

COMMIT;

-- TABLE: fact_sentiment
BEGIN;

-- Preserve undated social rows and label provisional sentiment rules.
INSERT INTO fact_sentiment (
    source, source_id, feedback_date, rating, sentiment_label, classification_method, platform,
    feedback_text, posted_epoch_raw, likes, shares, comments
)
SELECT 'App Store', review_id, review_date, rating,
        CASE WHEN rating >= 4 THEN 'Positive' WHEN rating <= 2 THEN 'Negative'
            WHEN rating = 3 THEN 'Neutral' END,
        'rating_rule', platform, review_text, NULL::BIGINT, NULL::INT, NULL::INT, NULL::INT
FROM public.raw_app_store_reviews
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Social Media', post_id, post_timestamp_ist::DATE, NULL::INT,
        CASE WHEN text IS NULL OR BTRIM(text) = '' THEN NULL
            WHEN text ~ *
                '(not good|not happy|not satisfied|bad|worst|poor|fail|broken|refund|delay|stranded|fire|smoke|unsafe|frustrat|disappoint|no response)'
                THEN 'Negative'
            WHEN text ~ * '(great|excellent|love|happy|satisfied|smooth|awesome|impress|thank)' THEN
                'Positive'
            ELSE 'Neutral' END,
        'keyword_v1_provisional_negative_first', platform, text, posted_epoch_raw, likes, shares,
            comments
FROM public.raw_social_media_posts
ON CONFLICT (source, source_id) DO UPDATE SET
    feedback_date = EXCLUDED.feedback_date, rating = EXCLUDED.rating,
    sentiment_label = EXCLUDED.sentiment_label, classification_method =
        EXCLUDED.classification_method,
    platform = EXCLUDED.platform, feedback_text = EXCLUDED.feedback_text,
    posted_epoch_raw = EXCLUDED.posted_epoch_raw, likes = EXCLUDED.likes, shares = EXCLUDED.shares,
    comments = EXCLUDED.comments;

COMMIT;

-- TABLE: fact_nch_complaints
BEGIN;

INSERT INTO fact_nch_complaints (
    nch_ref_id, filed_date, state, category, status, escalated_to_ccpa, resolution_days,
    compensation_inr
)
SELECT nch_ref_id, filed_date, state, category, status, escalated_to_ccpa,
        resolution_days, compensation_inr FROM public.raw_nch_ccpa_complaints
ON CONFLICT (nch_ref_id) DO UPDATE SET
    filed_date = EXCLUDED.filed_date, state = EXCLUDED.state, category = EXCLUDED.category,
    status = EXCLUDED.status, escalated_to_ccpa = EXCLUDED.escalated_to_ccpa,
    resolution_days = EXCLUDED.resolution_days, compensation_inr = EXCLUDED.compensation_inr;

COMMIT;

-- TABLE: fact_competitor_incidents
BEGIN;

INSERT INTO fact_competitor_incidents (
    incident_id, oem, incident_date, incident_type, units_affected, resolution_days, source
)
SELECT incident_id, UPPER(BTRIM(oem)), incident_date, incident_type, units_affected,
    resolution_days, source
FROM public.raw_competitor_incidents
ON CONFLICT (incident_id) DO UPDATE SET
    oem = EXCLUDED.oem, incident_date = EXCLUDED.incident_date, incident_type =
        EXCLUDED.incident_type,
    units_affected = EXCLUDED.units_affected, resolution_days = EXCLUDED.resolution_days,
    source = EXCLUDED.source;

COMMIT;

-- Reconcile loaded rows, units and known revenue against the sources.
WITH counts AS (
SELECT 'sales' AS source, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM _src_sales) AS expected_rows,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales) AS loaded_rows
UNION ALL
SELECT 'complaints' AS source, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM _src_complaints) AS expected_rows,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_complaints) AS loaded_rows
UNION ALL
SELECT 'jobcards' AS source, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.raw_job_cards_2024) AS expected_rows,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_jobcards) AS loaded_rows
UNION ALL
SELECT 'warranty' AS source, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.raw_warranty_claims) AS expected_rows,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_warranty) AS loaded_rows
UNION ALL
SELECT 'vahan' AS source, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.raw_vahan_competitor_registrations) AS
    expected_rows,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_vahan_registrations) AS loaded_rows
UNION ALL
SELECT 'spares' AS source, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.raw_spare_parts_consumption) AS
    expected_rows,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_spare_parts) AS loaded_rows
UNION ALL
SELECT 'nch' AS source, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.raw_nch_ccpa_complaints) AS expected_rows,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_nch_complaints) AS loaded_rows
UNION ALL
SELECT 'incidents' AS source, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.raw_competitor_incidents) AS
    expected_rows,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_competitor_incidents) AS loaded_rows
UNION ALL
SELECT 'sentiment', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.raw_app_store_reviews) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM
    public.raw_social_media_posts), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sentiment)
)
SELECT *, loaded_rows - expected_rows AS difference FROM counts ORDER BY source;
SELECT (SELECT SUM(units_sold) FROM _src_sales) AS expected_units,
        (SELECT SUM(units_sold) FROM fact_sales) AS loaded_units,
        (SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM _src_sales) AS expected_known_revenue,
        (SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM fact_sales) AS loaded_known_revenue,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM _src_sales WHERE revenue IS NULL) AS expected_unknown_revenue_rows,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales WHERE revenue IS NULL) AS loaded_unknown_revenue_rows;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS noncanonical_core_oem_rows
FROM (
    SELECT oem FROM fact_sales UNION ALL SELECT oem FROM fact_complaints
    UNION ALL SELECT oem FROM fact_jobcards UNION ALL SELECT oem FROM fact_warranty
) f WHERE oem IS DISTINCT FROM 'OLA ELECTRIC';

-- Confirm the connection targets new_ola_analytics.
SELECT current_database() AS database_name, current_database() = 'new_ola_analytics' AS
    correct_database;

-- Reconcile source and target row counts; each difference should be zero.
WITH counts AS (
    SELECT 'sales' AS fact_name,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.raw_ola_sales_daily_2023) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM
            public.raw_ola_sales_daily_2024)
        + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.raw_archived_sales_legacy l WHERE NOT EXISTS
            (SELECT 1 FROM public.raw_ola_sales_daily_2023 n WHERE n.sale_date = l.sale_date AND
                n.city = l.city AND n.model = l.model)) AS expected_rows,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ola_star.fact_sales) AS actual_rows
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'complaints', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.raw_service_complaints_2023) + (SELECT
        COUNT(*) FROM public.raw_service_complaints_2024), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM
        ola_star.fact_complaints)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'jobcards', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.raw_job_cards_2024), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM
        ola_star.fact_jobcards)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'warranty', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.raw_warranty_claims), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM
        ola_star.fact_warranty)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'vahan', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.raw_vahan_competitor_registrations), (SELECT
        COUNT(*) FROM ola_star.fact_vahan_registrations)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'spares', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.raw_spare_parts_consumption), (SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM ola_star.fact_spare_parts)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'reviews', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.raw_app_store_reviews), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM
        ola_star.fact_sentiment WHERE source = 'App Store')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'social', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.raw_social_media_posts), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM
        ola_star.fact_sentiment WHERE source = 'Social Media')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'nch', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.raw_nch_ccpa_complaints), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM
        ola_star.fact_nch_complaints)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'incidents', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.raw_competitor_incidents), (SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM ola_star.fact_competitor_incidents)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'identifier_associations', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.master_id_map), (SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM ola_star.vw_vehicle_identifier_map)
)
SELECT *, actual_rows - expected_rows AS difference FROM counts ORDER BY fact_name;

-- Orphan vehicle keys should be zero; unmapped identities measure coverage gaps.
WITH ids AS (
    SELECT 'complaints' AS source, vehicle_customer_key FROM ola_star.fact_complaints
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'jobcards', vehicle_customer_key FROM ola_star.fact_jobcards
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'warranty', vehicle_customer_key FROM ola_star.fact_warranty
)
SELECT i.source, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.vehicle_customer_key IS NOT NULL AND
    v.vehicle_customer_key IS NULL) AS orphan_keys,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.vehicle_customer_key IS NULL) AS unmapped_rows,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE v.identity_type IN ('CUSTOMER_ONLY', 'MOBILE_ONLY')) AS
            unresolved_vehicle_rows
FROM ids i LEFT JOIN ola_star.dim_vehicle_customer v USING (vehicle_customer_key) GROUP BY i.source
    ORDER BY i.source;

-- Duplicate business keys should return no rows.
SELECT 'sales' AS source, concat_ws('|', sale_date::TEXT, city, model) AS business_key, COUNT(*) AS
    copies
FROM ola_star.fact_sales GROUP BY sale_date, city, model HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'complaints', ticket_id, COUNT(*) FROM ola_star.fact_complaints GROUP BY ticket_id HAVING
    COUNT(*) > 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'jobcards', jobcard_id, COUNT(*) FROM ola_star.fact_jobcards GROUP BY jobcard_id HAVING
    COUNT(*) > 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'warranty', claim_id, COUNT(*) FROM ola_star.fact_warranty GROUP BY claim_id HAVING COUNT(*)
    > 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'vehicles', identity_type || ':' || identity_value, COUNT(*) FROM
    ola_star.dim_vehicle_customer GROUP BY identity_type, identity_value HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'vahan', concat_ws('|', reg_date::TEXT, rto_city, oem, vehicle_class), COUNT(*) FROM
    ola_star.fact_vahan_registrations GROUP BY reg_date, rto_city, oem, vehicle_class HAVING
    COUNT(*) > 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'spares', concat_ws('|', week_start::TEXT, center_id, part_code), COUNT(*) FROM
    ola_star.fact_spare_parts GROUP BY week_start, center_id, part_code HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'sentiment', source || ':' || source_id, COUNT(*) FROM ola_star.fact_sentiment GROUP BY
    source, source_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'nch', nch_ref_id, COUNT(*) FROM ola_star.fact_nch_complaints GROUP BY nch_ref_id HAVING
    COUNT(*) > 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'incidents', incident_id, COUNT(*) FROM ola_star.fact_competitor_incidents GROUP BY
    incident_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

-- Report missing data and known conflicts without assuming every count is zero.
SELECT 'complaints_missing_confirmed_date' AS metric, COUNT(*)::NUMERIC AS value FROM
    ola_star.fact_complaints WHERE complaint_date IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'complaints_inferred_date_available', COUNT(*) FROM ola_star.fact_complaints WHERE
    complaint_date IS NULL AND complaint_date_inferred IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'social_missing_date', COUNT(*) FROM ola_star.fact_sentiment WHERE source = 'Social Media'
    AND feedback_date IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'social_unclassified', COUNT(*) FROM ola_star.fact_sentiment WHERE source = 'Social Media'
    AND sentiment_label IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'resolved_missing_resolution', COUNT(*) FROM ola_star.fact_complaints WHERE
    UPPER(TRIM(status)) IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED') AND resolution_date IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'placeholder_centres', COUNT(*) FROM ola_star.dim_service_center WHERE source_record_missing
UNION ALL
SELECT 'jobcards_unmatched_ticket', COUNT(*) FROM ola_star.fact_jobcards WHERE linked_ticket_id IS
    NOT NULL AND linked_ticket_key IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'status_conflicting_jobcards', COUNT(*) FROM ola_star.vw_cross_validation_discrepancies
UNION ALL
SELECT 'status_conflicting_tickets', COUNT(DISTINCT ticket_id) FROM
    ola_star.vw_cross_validation_discrepancies
UNION ALL
SELECT 'multiple_customer_vehicles', COUNT(*) FROM ola_star.dim_vehicle_customer WHERE
    multiple_customers_flag
UNION ALL
SELECT 'component_agreement_pct', ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(BTRIM(component_tag)) =
    LOWER(BTRIM(component_extracted)))*100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2)
FROM ola_star.fact_complaints WHERE component_tag IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(BTRIM(component_tag)) NOT IN
    ('', 'null', '[null]');

-- Reconcile sales totals using new-system precedence over overlapping legacy rows.
WITH expected AS (
    SELECT units_sold, units_sold*avg_selling_price_inr AS revenue FROM
        public.raw_ola_sales_daily_2023
    UNION ALL
    SELECT units_sold, units_sold*avg_selling_price_inr FROM public.raw_ola_sales_daily_2024
    UNION ALL
    SELECT l.units_sold, l.revenue FROM public.raw_archived_sales_legacy l
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.raw_ola_sales_daily_2023 n WHERE n.sale_date =
        l.sale_date AND n.city = l.city AND n.model = l.model)
)
SELECT (SELECT SUM(units_sold) FROM expected) AS expected_units,
        (SELECT SUM(units_sold) FROM ola_star.fact_sales) AS loaded_units,
        (SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM expected) AS expected_revenue_inr,
        (SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM ola_star.fact_sales) AS loaded_revenue_inr,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM expected WHERE revenue IS NULL) AS expected_unknown_revenue_rows,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ola_star.fact_sales WHERE revenue IS NULL) AS
            loaded_unknown_revenue_rows;

-- TABLE: public.raw_service_complaints_2023, public.raw_service_complaints_2024
-- Check for negative or inconsistent TAT while reporting missing dates separately.
WITH complaints AS (
    SELECT
        '2023' AS source_year,
        complaint_date,
        resolution_date,
        UPPER(TRIM(status)) AS status,
        tat_days
    FROM public.raw_service_complaints_2023

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        '2024',
        complaint_date,
        resolution_date,
        UPPER(TRIM(status)),
        tat_days
    FROM public.raw_service_complaints_2024
)
SELECT
    source_year,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE complaint_date IS NULL
    ) AS missing_complaint_dates,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE resolution_date IS NULL
            AND status IN (
                'OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'IN PROGRESS', 'ESCALATED'
            )
    ) AS unresolved_without_resolution_date,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE resolution_date IS NULL
            AND status IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED')
    ) AS resolved_missing_resolution_date,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE resolution_date IS NULL
            AND (
                status IS NULL
                OR status NOT IN (
                    'OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'IN PROGRESS',
                    'ESCALATED', 'RESOLVED', 'CLOSED'
                )
            )
    ) AS other_status_missing_resolution_date,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE resolution_date < complaint_date
    ) AS negative_tat_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE tat_days IS DISTINCT FROM
                (resolution_date - complaint_date)
    ) AS tat_mismatch_rows
FROM complaints
GROUP BY source_year
ORDER BY source_year;

-- Compare extracted components with existing tags; target at least 90% agreement.
WITH complaints AS (
    SELECT
        '2023' AS source_year,
        component_tag,
        component_extracted
    FROM public.raw_service_complaints_2023

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        '2024',
        component_tag,
        component_extracted
    FROM public.raw_service_complaints_2024
)
SELECT
    source_year,
    COUNT(*) AS tagged_tickets,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE LOWER(TRIM(component_tag)) =
                LOWER(TRIM(component_extracted))
    ) AS matching_tickets,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE LOWER(TRIM(component_tag)) =
                    LOWER(TRIM(component_extracted))
        ) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
        2
    ) AS agreement_pct
FROM complaints
WHERE component_tag IS NOT NULL
    AND LOWER(TRIM(component_tag)) NOT IN ('', '[null]', 'null')
GROUP BY source_year
ORDER BY source_year;

-- Report missing severity and CSAT; ratings outside 1–5 should be zero.
WITH complaints AS (
    SELECT
        '2023' AS source_year,
        severity,
        csat_score,
        UPPER(TRIM(status)) AS status
    FROM public.raw_service_complaints_2023

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        '2024',
        severity,
        csat_score,
        UPPER(TRIM(status))
    FROM public.raw_service_complaints_2024
)
SELECT
    source_year,
    COUNT(*) AS total_tickets,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE severity IS NULL
            OR LOWER(TRIM(severity)) IN ('', '[null]', 'null')
    ) AS missing_severity,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE csat_score IS NULL
    ) AS missing_csat,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE status IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED')
            AND csat_score IS NULL
    ) AS resolved_missing_csat,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE csat_score < 1 OR csat_score > 5
    ) AS invalid_csat
FROM complaints
GROUP BY source_year
ORDER BY source_year;

-- TABLE: public.raw_job_cards_2024
-- Review technician assignments and missing or inconsistent job dates.
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_job_cards,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE technician_id IS NULL
            OR LOWER(TRIM(technician_id)) IN ('', '[null]', 'null')
    ) AS missing_technician,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE UPPER(TRIM(technician_id)) = 'UNASSIGNED'
    ) AS unassigned_technician,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE open_date IS NULL
    ) AS missing_open_date,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE close_date IS NULL
    ) AS missing_close_date,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE close_date IS NULL
            AND UPPER(TRIM(status)) IN ('CLOSED', 'RESOLVED', 'COMPLETED')
    ) AS completed_without_close_date,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE close_date < open_date
    ) AS close_before_open
FROM public.raw_job_cards_2024;

-- TABLE: public.raw_warranty_claims
-- Validate currency conversion using the project assumption of INR 84 per USD.
SELECT
    UPPER(TRIM(currency)) AS source_currency,
    COUNT(*) AS total_claims,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE is_usd_converted IS TRUE
    ) AS flagged_converted,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE claim_amount IS NULL
            OR claim_amount_inr IS NULL
    ) AS missing_amounts,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE
            CASE UPPER(TRIM(currency))
                WHEN 'USD' THEN
                    claim_amount_inr IS DISTINCT FROM claim_amount * 84
                    OR is_usd_converted IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
                WHEN 'INR' THEN
                    claim_amount_inr IS DISTINCT FROM claim_amount
                    OR is_usd_converted IS DISTINCT FROM FALSE
                ELSE TRUE
            END
    ) AS rows_needing_review
FROM public.raw_warranty_claims
GROUP BY UPPER(TRIM(currency))
ORDER BY source_currency;

-- TABLE: public.raw_archived_sales_legacy, public.raw_ola_sales_daily_2023
-- Quantify legacy overlap and quantity conflicts without deleting records.
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS legacy_rows,
    COUNT(n.sale_date) AS overlapping_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE n.sale_date IS NOT NULL
            AND l.units_sold IS DISTINCT FROM n.units_sold
    ) AS quantity_conflicts,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE n.sale_date IS NOT NULL
            AND l.units_sold IS NOT DISTINCT FROM n.units_sold
    ) AS matching_quantity_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE n.sale_date IS NULL
    ) AS legacy_only_rows
FROM public.raw_archived_sales_legacy l
LEFT JOIN public.raw_ola_sales_daily_2023 n
    ON l.sale_date = n.sale_date
    AND l.city = n.city
    AND l.model = n.model;

-- TABLE: public.raw_app_store_reviews
-- Check rating validity and review-date coverage.
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_reviews,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE rating IS NULL
    ) AS missing_ratings,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE rating < 1 OR rating > 5
    ) AS out_of_range_ratings,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE rating <> TRUNC(rating::NUMERIC)
    ) AS fractional_ratings,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE review_date IS NULL
    ) AS missing_review_dates,
    MIN(review_date) AS earliest_review,
    MAX(review_date) AS latest_review
FROM public.raw_app_store_reviews;

-- TABLE: public.raw_service_complaints_2023, public.raw_service_complaints_2024
-- Report missing registrations without excluding those complaints.
WITH complaints AS (
    SELECT
        '2023' AS source_year,
        vehicle_reg_no
    FROM public.raw_service_complaints_2023

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        '2024',
        vehicle_reg_no
    FROM public.raw_service_complaints_2024
)
SELECT
    source_year,
    COUNT(*) AS total_complaints,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE vehicle_reg_no IS NULL
            OR LOWER(TRIM(vehicle_reg_no)) IN ('', '[null]', 'null')
    ) AS missing_registration,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE vehicle_reg_no IS NULL
                OR LOWER(TRIM(vehicle_reg_no)) IN ('', '[null]', 'null')
        ) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
        2
    ) AS missing_registration_pct
FROM complaints
GROUP BY source_year
ORDER BY source_year;

-- TABLE: public.master_id_map
-- Duplicate associations and rows with no identifiers should be zero.
WITH combinations AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        vehicle_reg_no,
        chassis_no,
        mobile_hash,
        COUNT(*) AS rows_per_combination
    FROM public.master_id_map
    GROUP BY
        customer_id,
        vehicle_reg_no,
        chassis_no,
        mobile_hash
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(rows_per_combination), 0) AS total_mapping_rows,
    COUNT(*) AS distinct_combinations,
    COALESCE(SUM(rows_per_combination - 1), 0) AS duplicate_mapping_rows,
    COALESCE(SUM(rows_per_combination) FILTER (
        WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
            AND vehicle_reg_no IS NOT NULL
            AND chassis_no IS NOT NULL
            AND mobile_hash IS NOT NULL
    ), 0) AS complete_mapping_rows,
    COALESCE(SUM(rows_per_combination) FILTER (
        WHERE customer_id IS NULL
            AND vehicle_reg_no IS NULL
            AND chassis_no IS NULL
            AND mobile_hash IS NULL
    ), 0) AS all_identifiers_null
FROM combinations;

-- Multiple join-key matches indicate relationships, not necessarily duplicates.
WITH key_counts AS (
    SELECT
        'customer + registration' AS join_key,
        COUNT(*) AS matching_rows
    FROM public.master_id_map
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
        AND vehicle_reg_no IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY customer_id, vehicle_reg_no

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'registration',
        COUNT(*)
    FROM public.master_id_map
    WHERE vehicle_reg_no IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY vehicle_reg_no

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'chassis',
        COUNT(*)
    FROM public.master_id_map
    WHERE chassis_no IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY chassis_no

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'chassis + mobile',
        COUNT(*)
    FROM public.master_id_map
    WHERE chassis_no IS NOT NULL
        AND mobile_hash IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY chassis_no, mobile_hash
)
SELECT
    join_key,
    COUNT(*) AS distinct_keys,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE matching_rows > 1
    ) AS keys_with_multiple_matches,
    MAX(matching_rows) AS maximum_matches
FROM key_counts
GROUP BY join_key
ORDER BY join_key;

-- TABLE: ola_star.dim_oem
-- Check for OEM names that differ only by case or surrounding spaces.
SELECT LOWER(BTRIM(oem_name)) AS normalized_oem, COUNT(*) AS dimension_rows FROM ola_star.dim_oem
    GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

-- Core facts should contain only the canonical OLA ELECTRIC label.
SELECT COUNT(*) AS noncanonical_core_oem_rows
FROM (SELECT oem FROM ola_star.fact_sales UNION ALL
SELECT oem FROM ola_star.fact_complaints
        UNION ALL
        SELECT oem FROM ola_star.fact_jobcards UNION ALL
SELECT oem FROM ola_star.fact_warranty) f
WHERE oem IS DISTINCT FROM 'OLA ELECTRIC';

-- TABLE: ola_star.fact_sales
-- Compare sales rows in both directions, preserving NULL measures.
WITH expected AS (
    SELECT sale_date, city, model, units_sold, units_sold*avg_selling_price_inr AS revenue
    FROM public.raw_ola_sales_daily_2023
    UNION ALL
    SELECT sale_date, city, model, units_sold, units_sold*avg_selling_price_inr
    FROM public.raw_ola_sales_daily_2024
    UNION ALL
    SELECT l.sale_date, l.city, l.model, l.units_sold, l.revenue FROM
        public.raw_archived_sales_legacy l
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.raw_ola_sales_daily_2023 n
    WHERE n.sale_date = l.sale_date AND n.city = l.city AND n.model = l.model)
), missing_or_changed AS (
    SELECT * FROM expected
    EXCEPT ALL SELECT sale_date, city, model, units_sold, revenue FROM ola_star.fact_sales
), extra_or_changed AS (
    SELECT sale_date, city, model, units_sold, revenue FROM ola_star.fact_sales
    EXCEPT ALL SELECT * FROM expected
)
SELECT 'source_rows_not_matched' AS check_name, COUNT(*) AS mismatching_rows FROM missing_or_changed
UNION ALL
SELECT 'target_rows_not_matched', COUNT(*) FROM extra_or_changed;

-- TABLE: ola_star.fact_complaints
-- Compare confirmed complaint dates and calculated TAT against source rows.
WITH expected AS (
    SELECT ticket_id, complaint_date, resolution_date, resolution_date - complaint_date AS tat_days
    FROM public.raw_service_complaints_2023
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ticket_id, complaint_date, resolution_date, resolution_date - complaint_date
    FROM public.raw_service_complaints_2024
), missing_or_changed AS (
    SELECT * FROM expected
    EXCEPT ALL SELECT ticket_id, complaint_date, resolution_date, tat_days FROM
        ola_star.fact_complaints
), extra_or_changed AS (
    SELECT ticket_id, complaint_date, resolution_date, tat_days FROM ola_star.fact_complaints
    EXCEPT ALL SELECT * FROM expected
)
SELECT 'source_rows_not_matched' AS check_name, COUNT(*) AS mismatching_rows FROM missing_or_changed
UNION ALL
SELECT 'target_rows_not_matched', COUNT(*) FROM extra_or_changed;

-- TABLE: ola_star.fact_warranty
-- Claim-month amounts include all approval states and do not represent payouts.
SELECT
    d.year,
    d.month,
    w.part_name,
    COUNT(w.claim_id) AS claim_count,
    ROUND(SUM(w.claim_amount_inr), 2) AS total_warranty_cost_inr,
    ROUND(AVG(w.claim_amount_inr), 2) AS avg_claim_cost_inr
FROM ola_star.fact_warranty w
JOIN ola_star.dim_date d
    ON w.claim_date = d.date_key
GROUP BY d.year, d.month, w.part_name
ORDER BY d.year, d.month, total_warranty_cost_inr DESC;

-- TABLE: ola_star.fact_complaints
-- Count all ticket statuses; average CSAT uses resolved or closed tickets only.
SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS total_tickets, ROUND(AVG(tat_days), 1) AS avg_tat_days,
        ROUND(AVG(csat_score) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(TRIM(status)) IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED')), 2) AS
            avg_csat
FROM ola_star.fact_complaints WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY total_tickets DESC, customer_id;

-- The seven-day rate uses resolved or closed tickets with known TAT as its denominator.
SELECT d.year, d.month, COUNT(*) AS total_resolved_tickets,
        COUNT(c.tat_days) AS resolved_tickets_with_known_tat,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.tat_days <= 7) AS resolved_within_7d,
        ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.tat_days <= 7)*100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(c.tat_days), 0), 2) AS
            pct_resolved_within_7d_known_tat
FROM ola_star.fact_complaints c JOIN ola_star.dim_date d ON c.complaint_date = d.date_key
WHERE UPPER(TRIM(c.status)) IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED')
GROUP BY d.year, d.month ORDER BY d.year, d.month;

-- TABLE: ola_star.dim_part
-- Stockout frequency counts centre-part-weeks, not distinct calendar weeks.
SELECT p.member_code AS part_code, p.part_name,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ola_star.fact_spare_parts s WHERE s.part_key = p.part_key AND
            s.stockout_days > 0) AS stockout_center_part_weeks,
        (SELECT SUM(s.stockout_days) FROM ola_star.fact_spare_parts s WHERE s.part_key = p.part_key)
            AS total_stockout_days
FROM ola_star.dim_part p WHERE p.member_type = 'PART' ORDER BY stockout_center_part_weeks DESC,
    p.member_code;

-- TABLE: ola_star.fact_complaints
-- Group current ESCALATED statuses by complaint month, not escalation date.
SELECT
    d.year,
    d.month,
    COUNT(c.ticket_id) AS total_tickets,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(c.status)) = 'ESCALATED' THEN 1 END) AS escalated_tickets,
    ROUND(
        COUNT(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(c.status)) = 'ESCALATED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 /
            NULLIF(COUNT(c.ticket_id), 0),
        2
    ) AS escalation_rate_pct
FROM ola_star.fact_complaints c
JOIN ola_star.dim_date d
    ON c.complaint_date = d.date_key
GROUP BY d.year, d.month
ORDER BY d.year, d.month;

-- Compare known TAT and CSAT for resolved or closed tickets; low CSAT is 2 or below.
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN tat_days BETWEEN 0 AND 3 THEN '1. 0-3 Days'
        WHEN tat_days BETWEEN 4 AND 7 THEN '2. 4-7 Days'
        WHEN tat_days BETWEEN 8 AND 14 THEN '3. 8-14 Days'
        WHEN tat_days > 14 THEN '4. >14 Days'
        ELSE 'Unresolved / Discrepant'
    END AS tat_band,
    COUNT(ticket_id) AS total_tickets,
    ROUND(AVG(csat_score), 2) AS avg_csat_score,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN csat_score <= 2 THEN 1 END) AS low_csat_count
FROM ola_star.fact_complaints
WHERE UPPER(TRIM(status)) IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED') AND csat_score IS NOT NULL AND tat_days IS
    NOT NULL AND tat_days >= 0
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY tat_band;

-- TABLE: ola_star.fact_spare_parts
-- The stockout-rate denominator is all loaded centre-part-weeks.
SELECT
    COUNT(part_name) AS total_part_weeks,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN stockout_days > 0 THEN 1 END) AS stockout_weeks,
    ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN stockout_days > 0 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(part_name), 0), 2) AS
        stockout_rate_pct
FROM ola_star.fact_spare_parts;

-- TABLE: ola_star.fact_complaints
-- Average TAT excludes missing values; recorded TAT does not confirm final resolution.
SELECT
    status,
    COUNT(ticket_id) AS ticket_count,
    ROUND(AVG(tat_days), 1) AS average_tat,
    MAX(tat_days) AS max_tat_days
FROM ola_star.fact_complaints
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY ticket_count DESC;

-- TABLE: ola_star.fact_warranty
-- Rank claim amounts across all approval states, not actual warranty payouts.
SELECT p.category, w.part_name, COUNT(w.claim_id) AS total_claims, SUM(w.claim_amount_inr) AS
    total_cost_inr
FROM ola_star.fact_warranty w LEFT JOIN ola_star.dim_part p ON w.part_key = p.part_key
GROUP BY p.category, w.part_name ORDER BY total_cost_inr DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

-- TABLE: ola_star.fact_complaints
-- Component volumes support intent design but are not validated chatbot intent counts.
SELECT component_extracted, COUNT(*) AS ticket_volume FROM ola_star.fact_complaints GROUP BY
    component_extracted ORDER BY ticket_volume DESC;

-- Compare January and October 2024 resolved cohorts, reporting missing TAT separately.
WITH months AS (
    SELECT DATE '2024-01-01' AS month_start
    UNION ALL SELECT DATE '2024-10-01'
)
SELECT m.month_start,
        COUNT(c.ticket_id) AS resolved_tickets,
        COUNT(c.tat_days) AS tickets_with_known_tat,
        COUNT(c.ticket_id) - COUNT(c.tat_days) AS tickets_missing_tat,
        ROUND(AVG(c.tat_days), 2) AS mean_tat_days,
        ROUND((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c.tat_days))::NUMERIC, 2)
            AS median_tat_days
FROM months m
LEFT JOIN ola_star.fact_complaints c
    ON c.complaint_date >= m.month_start
    AND c.complaint_date < m.month_start + INTERVAL '1 month'
    AND UPPER(BTRIM(c.status)) IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED')
GROUP BY m.month_start ORDER BY m.month_start;

-- Compare cohort percentages using identical three-day bins, including empty bins.
WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT date_trunc('month', complaint_date)::DATE AS month_start,
        (tat_days / 3) * 3 AS bin_start_days
    FROM ola_star.fact_complaints
    WHERE UPPER(BTRIM(status)) IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED') AND tat_days >= 0
    AND ((complaint_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND complaint_date < DATE '2024-02-01')
        OR (complaint_date >= DATE '2024-10-01' AND complaint_date < DATE '2024-11-01'))
), months AS (
    SELECT DATE '2024-01-01' AS month_start UNION ALL SELECT DATE '2024-10-01'
), bins AS (
    SELECT generate_series(0, COALESCE(MAX(bin_start_days), 0), 3) AS bin_start_days FROM eligible
), counts AS (
    SELECT month_start, bin_start_days, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count
    FROM eligible GROUP BY month_start, bin_start_days
), totals AS (
    SELECT month_start, COUNT(*) AS eligible_tickets FROM eligible GROUP BY month_start
)
SELECT m.month_start, b.bin_start_days, b.bin_start_days + 2 AS bin_end_days,
        COALESCE(c.ticket_count, 0) AS ticket_count,
        ROUND(COALESCE(c.ticket_count, 0)*100.0 / NULLIF(t.eligible_tickets, 0), 2)
            AS pct_of_eligible_tickets
FROM months m CROSS JOIN bins b
LEFT JOIN counts c USING (month_start, bin_start_days)
LEFT JOIN totals t USING (month_start)
ORDER BY m.month_start, b.bin_start_days;

-- Pearson correlation uses eligible resolved pairs and does not establish causation.
SELECT COUNT(*) AS resolved_tickets,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE csat_score IS NOT NULL AND tat_days >= 0) AS eligible_pairs,
        ROUND((CORR(csat_score::DOUBLE PRECISION, tat_days::DOUBLE PRECISION)
            FILTER (WHERE csat_score IS NOT NULL AND tat_days >= 0))::NUMERIC, 4)
            AS pearson_correlation
FROM ola_star.fact_complaints
WHERE UPPER(BTRIM(status)) IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED');

-- TABLE: ola_star.fact_sales
-- LAG compares consecutive populated months; missing months are not filled.
SELECT
    d.year,
    d.month,
    SUM(s.units_sold) AS total_units_sold,
    LAG(SUM(s.units_sold)) OVER (ORDER BY d.year, d.month) AS prev_month_sales,
    ROUND(
        (SUM(s.units_sold) - LAG(SUM(s.units_sold)) OVER (ORDER BY d.year, d.month))
        * 100.0 / NULLIF(
            LAG(SUM(s.units_sold)) OVER (ORDER BY d.year, d.month), 0
        ),
        2
    ) AS mom_growth_pct
FROM ola_star.fact_sales s
JOIN ola_star.dim_date d ON s.sale_date = d.date_key
GROUP BY d.year, d.month
ORDER BY d.year, d.month;

-- Cumulative sales assume zero opening fleet and exclude retirements or returns.
WITH MonthlySales AS (
    SELECT
        d.year,
        d.month,
        SUM(s.units_sold) AS monthly_sales
    FROM ola_star.fact_sales s
    JOIN ola_star.dim_date d ON s.sale_date = d.date_key
    GROUP BY d.year, d.month
)
SELECT
    year,
    month,
    monthly_sales,
    SUM(monthly_sales) OVER (
        ORDER BY year, month
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS cumulative_vehicles_on_road
FROM MonthlySales
ORDER BY year, month;

-- TABLE: ola_star.fact_complaints
-- Return at most five components per quarter, breaking count ties by component name.
WITH ComponentRanks AS (
    SELECT
        d.year,
        d.quarter,
        c.component_extracted,
        COUNT(*) AS total_complaints,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.year, d.quarter
            ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, c.component_extracted
        ) AS rnk
    FROM ola_star.fact_complaints c
    JOIN ola_star.dim_date d ON c.complaint_date = d.date_key
    GROUP BY d.year, d.quarter, c.component_extracted
)
SELECT
    year,
    quarter,
    component_extracted,
    total_complaints
FROM ComponentRanks
WHERE rnk <= 5
ORDER BY year, quarter, rnk;

-- Rank centres with at least 50 known-TAT tickets, including all statuses.
SELECT
    assigned_center_id,
    COUNT(ticket_id) AS total_tickets,
    ROUND(AVG(tat_days), 2) AS avg_tat_days,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(tat_days) DESC) AS tat_rank
FROM ola_star.fact_complaints
WHERE tat_days IS NOT NULL
    AND assigned_center_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY assigned_center_id
HAVING COUNT(ticket_id) >= 50
ORDER BY tat_rank, assigned_center_id;

-- VIEW: ola_star.vw_city_service_gap
-- Cumulative recorded sales approximate the fleet with a zero opening balance.
SELECT
    month_start,
    city,
    cumulative_vehicles,
    monthly_complaints,
    complaints_per_1000_vehicles
FROM ola_star.vw_city_service_gap
ORDER BY month_start, complaints_per_1000_vehicles DESC NULLS LAST, city;

-- TABLE: ola_star.fact_vahan_registrations
-- Join OEM-month aggregates to monthly totals; rounded shares may not sum to 100%.
WITH OEM_Monthly AS (
    SELECT
        d.year,
        d.month,
        v.oem,
        SUM(v.registrations) AS oem_regs
    FROM ola_star.fact_vahan_registrations v
    JOIN ola_star.dim_date d ON v.reg_date = d.date_key
    GROUP BY d.year, d.month, v.oem
),
Total_Monthly AS (
    SELECT
        d.year,
        d.month,
        SUM(v.registrations) AS total_regs
    FROM ola_star.fact_vahan_registrations v
    JOIN ola_star.dim_date d ON v.reg_date = d.date_key
    GROUP BY d.year, d.month
)
SELECT
    o.year,
    o.month,
    o.oem,
    o.oem_regs,
    t.total_regs,
    ROUND((o.oem_regs * 100.0) / NULLIF(t.total_regs, 0), 2) AS market_share_pct
FROM OEM_Monthly o
JOIN Total_Monthly t ON o.year = t.year AND o.month = t.month
ORDER BY o.year, o.month, market_share_pct DESC;

-- TABLE: ola_star.fact_complaints
-- Each result represents a matching job card, not a distinct complaint.
SELECT
    c.ticket_id,
    c.customer_id,
    c.vehicle_reg_no,
    c.city,
    c.status AS complaint_status,
    jc.jobcard_id,
    jc.status AS jobcard_status,
    jc.open_date AS jobcard_opened
FROM ola_star.fact_complaints c
JOIN ola_star.fact_jobcards jc
    ON c.ticket_id = jc.linked_ticket_id
WHERE UPPER(TRIM(jc.status)) = 'AWAITING_PARTS'
ORDER BY jc.open_date;

-- Return forward ticket pairs within 30 days, excluding same-day repeats and missing registrations.
SELECT
    c1.vehicle_reg_no,
    c1.ticket_id AS initial_ticket_id,
    c1.complaint_date AS initial_complaint_date,
    c1.component_extracted AS initial_component,
    c2.ticket_id AS repeat_ticket_id,
    c2.complaint_date AS repeat_complaint_date,
    c2.component_extracted AS repeat_component,
    (c2.complaint_date - c1.complaint_date) AS days_between_complaints
FROM ola_star.fact_complaints c1
JOIN ola_star.fact_complaints c2
    ON c1.vehicle_reg_no = c2.vehicle_reg_no
    AND c1.ticket_id <> c2.ticket_id
    AND (c2.complaint_date - c1.complaint_date) BETWEEN 1 AND 30
WHERE c1.vehicle_reg_no IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY days_between_complaints ASC, c1.vehicle_reg_no;

-- TABLE: ola_star.fact_jobcards
-- Eligibility requires a recorded close date, regardless of job status.
SELECT
    center_id,
    COUNT(*) AS completed_jobcards,
    ROUND(AVG(parts_cost_inr), 2) AS avg_parts_cost,
    ROUND(AVG(labour_cost_inr), 2) AS avg_labour_cost,
    COUNT(parts_cost_inr + labour_cost_inr) AS complete_cost_jobcards,
    ROUND(AVG(parts_cost_inr + labour_cost_inr), 2) AS avg_total_repair_cost
FROM ola_star.fact_jobcards
WHERE close_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY center_id
ORDER BY avg_total_repair_cost DESC NULLS LAST;

-- The first-time-fix proxy requires one known chassis and a full 30-day follow-up window.
WITH ticket_jobs AS (
    SELECT
        linked_ticket_key AS ticket_id,
        MIN(open_date) AS first_open_date,
        MIN(chassis_no) AS chassis_no
    FROM ola_star.fact_jobcards
    WHERE linked_ticket_key IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY linked_ticket_key
    HAVING COUNT(chassis_no) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT chassis_no) = 1
), eligible AS (
    SELECT
        t.*,
        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM ola_star.fact_jobcards j
            WHERE j.chassis_no = t.chassis_no
                AND j.open_date BETWEEN t.first_open_date AND t.first_open_date + 30
        ) <= 1 AS no_second_job
    FROM ticket_jobs t
    WHERE first_open_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-01'
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ola_star.fact_complaints) AS all_tickets,
    COUNT(*) AS eligible_tickets_with_full_30_day_followup,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE no_second_job) AS ftf_success_count,
    ROUND(
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE no_second_job) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
        2
    ) AS first_time_fix_rate_pct
FROM eligible;

-- VIEW: ola_star.vw_monthly_kpis
-- Exclude unconfirmed social dates; NULL sentiment means unavailable, not neutral.
SELECT
    year,
    month,
    dated_social_posts AS total_posts,
    sentiment_index
FROM ola_star.vw_monthly_kpis
ORDER BY year, month;

-- Positive calendar lags place complaints before sales; correlation does not establish causation.
WITH windows AS (
    SELECT '2023-2024' AS period, DATE '2023-01-01' AS start_date
    UNION ALL
    SELECT '2024', DATE '2024-01-01'
),
lags AS (
    SELECT generate_series(0, 3) AS lag_months
)
SELECT
    w.period,
    l.lag_months,
    COUNT(*) AS calendar_month_pairs,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE a.total_complaints IS NOT NULL AND b.monthly_sales IS NOT NULL
    ) AS eligible_month_pairs,
    CORR(
        a.total_complaints::DOUBLE PRECISION,
        b.monthly_sales::DOUBLE PRECISION
    ) AS pearson_r
FROM windows w
CROSS JOIN lags l
JOIN ola_star.vw_monthly_kpis a ON a.month_start >= w.start_date
JOIN ola_star.vw_monthly_kpis b
    ON b.month_start = (a.month_start + make_interval(months => l.lag_months))::DATE
WHERE b.month_start <= DATE '2024-12-01'
GROUP BY w.period, l.lag_months
ORDER BY w.period, l.lag_months;

-- VIEW: ola_star.vw_monthly_social_sales_illustrative
-- Requires the separate illustrative view; reconstructed dates are not confirmed evidence.
SELECT
    month_start,
    total_posts,
    positive_posts,
    negative_posts,
    neutral_posts,
    unclassified_posts,
    sentiment_index_illustrative,
    monthly_units_sold,
    analysis_note
FROM ola_star.vw_monthly_social_sales_illustrative
ORDER BY month_start;

-- Requires role-administration rights and ownership or grant rights on the objects.
BEGIN;

DO $roles$
DECLARE
    can_create BOOLEAN;
BEGIN
    SELECT rolsuper OR rolcreaterole INTO can_create
    FROM pg_roles
    WHERE rolname = current_user;

    IF NOT can_create THEN
        RAISE NOTICE 'DCL not executed: ask a database role administrator to run this DCL block';
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Required DCL was not executed';
    END IF;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'analyst_readonly') THEN
        CREATE ROLE analyst_readonly NOLOGIN;
    END IF;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'service_ops') THEN
        CREATE ROLE service_ops NOLOGIN;
    END IF;

    GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA ola_star, public TO analyst_readonly, service_ops;

    GRANT SELECT ON
        ola_star.vw_monthly_kpis,
        ola_star.vw_city_service_gap,
        ola_star.vw_vehicle_identifier_map,
        ola_star.vw_cross_validation_discrepancies
    TO analyst_readonly;

    GRANT SELECT ON public.vw_legacy_sales_conflicts TO analyst_readonly;

    -- TABLE: ola_star.fact_complaints
    GRANT SELECT, UPDATE ON ola_star.fact_complaints TO service_ops;
    REVOKE UPDATE ON ola_star.fact_complaints FROM service_ops;
    GRANT UPDATE ON ola_star.fact_complaints TO service_ops;
END $roles$;

COMMIT;

-- Verify the required permissions for both roles.
SELECT
    r.rolname AS role_name,
    has_schema_privilege(r.oid, 'ola_star', 'USAGE') AS schema_access,
    CASE
        WHEN r.rolname = 'analyst_readonly' THEN
            has_table_privilege(r.oid, 'ola_star.vw_monthly_kpis', 'SELECT')
            AND has_table_privilege(r.oid, 'ola_star.vw_city_service_gap', 'SELECT')
            AND has_table_privilege(r.oid, 'ola_star.vw_vehicle_identifier_map', 'SELECT')
            AND has_table_privilege(r.oid, 'ola_star.vw_cross_validation_discrepancies', 'SELECT')
        WHEN r.rolname = 'service_ops' THEN
            has_table_privilege(r.oid, 'ola_star.fact_complaints', 'SELECT')
            AND has_table_privilege(r.oid, 'ola_star.fact_complaints', 'UPDATE')
    END AS required_permissions
FROM pg_roles r
WHERE r.rolname IN ('analyst_readonly', 'service_ops')
ORDER BY r.rolname;

START TRANSACTION;

-- TABLE: demo_billing_ledger
CREATE TEMP TABLE demo_billing_ledger (
    entry_id INT PRIMARY KEY,
    charge_reference TEXT NOT NULL,
    entry_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (entry_type IN ('CHARGE', 'REFUND', 'REVERSAL')),
    amount_inr NUMERIC NOT NULL,
    CHECK (
        (entry_type = 'CHARGE' AND amount_inr > 0)
        OR (entry_type <> 'CHARGE' AND amount_inr < 0)
    )
) ON COMMIT DROP;

INSERT INTO demo_billing_ledger VALUES
    (1, 'DEMO-CHARGE', 'CHARGE', 1500),
    (2, 'DEMO-CHARGE', 'CHARGE', 1500);

INSERT INTO demo_billing_ledger VALUES (3, 'DEMO-CHARGE', 'REFUND', -1500);

SAVEPOINT before_duplicate_reversal;

-- Demonstrate rollback of an incorrect reversal before recording the correct amount.
INSERT INTO demo_billing_ledger VALUES (4, 'DEMO-CHARGE', 'REVERSAL', -150);

ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT before_duplicate_reversal;

INSERT INTO demo_billing_ledger VALUES (4, 'DEMO-CHARGE', 'REVERSAL', -1500);

SELECT SUM(amount_inr) AS expected_zero_balance FROM demo_billing_ledger;

DO $check$
DECLARE
    balance NUMERIC;
BEGIN
    SELECT SUM(amount_inr) INTO balance FROM demo_billing_ledger;

    IF balance IS DISTINCT FROM 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'TCL failed: balance=%', balance;
    END IF;

    RAISE NOTICE 'TCL check passed: balance = 0';
END $check$;

COMMIT;

Daily sales before and after the notice

1,217.91 → 725.31 units/day

1 Jan–6 Oct 2024: 280 days. 7 Oct–31 Dec: 86 days. Mean decline: 40.45%. Welch t = 17.091, approximate df = 164, p < .001. Serial dependence, seasonality and other changes limit causal interpretation.

Data integrity matters

3,870 job cards · 3,750 tickets

Resolved/closed complaint records conflict with open or awaiting-parts workshop jobs. Preserve both statuses and investigate; the discrepancy alone does not establish deliberate false closure.

Ola Care Assistant

SUPPORT AUTOMATION · STUDENT DEMO

Routine answers. A human route for safety.

The Botpress prototype covers 12 playbooks, including ticket status, service booking, charging, software, warranty and safety escalation. It uses fictional ticket records and project knowledge.

The recorded example shows safety guidance, a transfer notice, an agent joining and a human reply. It demonstrates one handoff; a complete 15-case test suite and production performance have not been established.

Try the chatbot demo ↗

Not official Ola customer support. Use fictional details. The demo opens on Botpress; availability depends on the hosted service.

What the eligibility sample supports

100 reviewed tickets across four groups included 26 eligible cases. Weighting each group’s sample eligibility by its historical ticket count projects 18,368 eligible ticket-equivalents, or 13.98% of all 131,366 tickets. Selection details and case-level reviews were not supplied.

8.39%estimated deflection · 11,021 ticket-equivalents

A sensitivity calculation, not measured contact reduction. Safety cases are excluded from self-service deflection. Success rate is an assumption; the eligibility projection also carries sampling uncertainty.

SWOT Analysis

Strengths

A large recorded vehicle base and direct customer visibility provide a foundation for targeted service improvement.

Weaknesses

Long repairs, critical-parts stockouts, inconsistent case status and incomplete identifiers weaken execution and measurement.

Opportunities

Targeted service capacity, better parts availability, maintenance pilots and reliable routine digital support.

Threats

Competitor share gains, poor satisfaction and regulatory scrutiny make recovery uncertain.

Four opportunities with explicit assumptions

OpportunityPlanning illustration
Service expansion100 centres reduce vehicles-per-centre proxy by 13.9% at a fixed base.
Parts availability25% fewer stockout weeks avoids approximately 5,083 weeks; rate falls to 24.44%.
Health-check pilot1% assumed uptake against recorded sales represents approximately 6,730 vehicles.
Digital support13.98% projected eligibility × 60% assumed success ≈ 8.39% estimated deflection (11,021 ticket-equivalents).

Overlapping planning illustrations, not additive realised benefits. Active-fleet eligibility, service economics and chatbot performance require validation.

Allocation of 100 proposed service centres

620 → 720 centres · 1,086 → 935 vehicles per centre

At December 2024’s fixed base of 673,048 recorded vehicles. Gap = max(0, ceil(vehicles / 1,000) − existing centres). Regional gaps total 108; distribute 100 proportionally using largest remainders, breaking ties by larger vehicle base then region name.

Proposed management rules, not official Ola targets or historical SLAs. Missing values and insufficient samples require data review, not a green status. Safety incidents bypass aggregate alerts.

First 30 days: reconcile conflicts and critical parts. Days 31–60: validate sites and pilot replenishment. Days 61–90: evaluate repair outcomes and scale improvements.
